الْحَمْدُ: الـ + حَمْد — ḥamd, praise (m., nom.); 'the praise'
لِلَّهِ: لِـ + اللَّه — Allāh, God (gen.); 'to God, God's' (the article's alif elides after li-)
رَبِّ: rabb — lord, master (m., gen. in apposition; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْعَالَمِينَ: الـ + عَالَمِين — ʿālam, world, created realm (m. sound pl., gen.); 'the worlds'
وَالصَّلَوةُ: وَ + الـ + صَلَوة — ṣalāh, prayer, blessing (f., nom.); 'and the blessing'
وَالسَّلَامُ: وَ + الـ + سَلَام — salām, peace, greeting (m., nom.)
عَلَى: ʿalā — on, upon, over (prep.); with سَلَّمَ, 'greeted'
سَيِّدِ: sayyid — lord, chief (m., gen. after ʿalā; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْمُرْسَلِينَ: الـ + مُرْسَلِين — mursal, one sent, messenger (pass. part. of IV arsala; m. pl., gen.)
سَيِّدِنَا: سَيِّد + ـنَا — sayyid, lord (m., gen.); 'our lord'
وَمَوْلَانَا: وَ + مَوْلَى + ـنَا — mawlā, master, patron (m., gen.); 'and our master'
مُحَمَّدٍ: Muḥammad — the Prophet's name (gen. with tanwīn, in apposition to sayyid)
صَلَّى: ṣallā — to bless, invoke blessing upon (verb II, perf. 3ms; with ʿalā)
اللَّهُ: Allāh — God (nom.; the name is treated as a single indivisible word)
عَلَيْهِ: عَلَى + ـهِ — ʿalā, on, upon (prep.) + 3ms; 'upon him'
وَسَلَّمَ: وَ + سَلَّمَ — sallama, to greet, salute, grant peace (verb II, perf. 3ms); with عَلَى
صَلَوةً: صَلَوة — ṣalāh, blessing (f., acc. as cognate object of ṣallā)
وَسَلَامًا: وَ + سَلَام — salām, peace (m., acc. as cognate object of sallama)
دَائِمَيْنِ: دَائِم (dual) — dāʾim, lasting, perpetual (act. part. of dāma; m. dual acc.)
مُتَلَازِمَيْنِ: مُتَلَازِم (dual) — mutalāzim, mutually inseparable, each attending the other (act. part. of VI talāzama; m. dual acc.)
إِلَى: ilā — to, toward, up to (prep.); with أَنْ + perfect, 'until'
يَوْمِ: yawm — day (m., gen. after ilā; first term of an iḍāfa)
الدِّينِ: الـ + دِين — dīn, judgment, requital, religion (m., gen.); yawm al-dīn = the Day of Judgment
وَبَعْدُ: وَ + بَعْدُ — baʿd, after (adv., indeclinable in -u); the formula 'and now, to proceed'
فَإِنَّ: فَـ + إِنَّ — fa-, so/then + inna, indeed, verily (particle putting its subject in the acc.)
سِيَرَ: سِيَر — sīra, life-story, career, biography (f. pl. of sīra; acc. as subject of inna)
الْأَوَّلِينَ: الـ + أَوَّلِين — awwal, first, former (m. pl., gen.); 'those of old, the ancients'
صَارَتْ: ṣāra — to become (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs; takes an acc. predicate)
عِبْرَةً: عِبْرَة — ʿibra, admonition, object-lesson, warning example (f., acc.)
لِلْآخِرِينَ: لِـ + الـ + آخِرِين — ākhir, latter, one who comes after (m. pl., gen.); 'for those who come after'
لِيَرَى: لِـ + يَرَى — raʾā, to see (verb I, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after the lām of purpose)
الْإِنْسَانُ: الـ + إِنْسَان — insān, human being, man (m., nom. as subject)
الْعِبَرَ: الـ + عِبَر — ʿibra, lesson (f. pl. ʿibar; acc. as object of yarā)
الَّتِي: allatī — who, which (rel. pron., f. sg.; the form used with non-human plurals as well)
حَصَلَتْ: ḥaṣala — to occur, come about, befall (verb I, perf. 3fs)
لِغَيْرِهِ: لِـ + غَيْر + ـهِ — ghayr, other-than (m., gen.); 'to someone other than himself'
فَيَعْتَبِرَ: فَـ + يَعْتَبِر — iʿtabara, to take warning, draw a lesson (verb VIII, imperf. 3ms subjunctive, coordinated with li-yarā)
وَيُطَالِعَ: وَ + يُطَالِع — ṭālaʿa, to peruse, look into, study (verb III, imperf. 3ms subjunctive)
حَدِيثَ: ḥadīth — account, narrative, report (m., acc. as object)
الْأُمَمِ: الـ + أُمَم — umma, nation, community (f. pl. umam; gen.)
السَّالِفَةِ: الـ + سَالِفَة — sālif, past, bygone (act. part.; f. sg. agreeing with the non-human pl., gen.)
وَمَا: وَ + مَا — mā, that which, what (rel. pron.)
جَرَى: jarā — to run, happen, come to pass, befall (verb I final-weak, perf. 3ms)
لَهُمْ: لِـ + ـهُمْ — li-, to + 3mp suffix; 'to them' (li- takes fatḥa before a suffix)
فَيَنْزَجِرَ: فَـ + يَنْزَجِر — inzajara, to be restrained, deterred, pull back (verb VII, imperf. 3ms subjunctive)
فَسُبْحَانَ: فَـ + سُبْحَان — subḥān, glorification (m., acc. in the fixed formula 'glory be to')
مَنْ: man — he who, the one who (rel. pron.)
جَعَلَ: jaʿala — to make, render, appoint (verb I, perf. 3ms; takes two objects)
لِقَوْمِ: لِـ + قَوْم — qawm, people, folk (m., gen.); 'for the folk of'
الْآخِرِينَ: الـ + آخِرِين — ākhir, latter, one who comes after (m. pl., gen.)
فَمِنْ: فَـ + مِنْ — min, from, of, among (prep.)
ذَلِكَ: dhālika — that (dem. pron., m. sg., invariable in form); فَمِنْ ذَلِكَ = 'an instance of that is'
الْعِبَرُ: الـ + عِبَر — ʿibra, admonition, object-lesson (f. pl. ʿibar; nom. as subject)
الْحِكَايَاتُ: الـ + حِكَايَات — ḥikāya, tale, story (f. pl.; nom., in apposition to al-ʿibar)
تُسَمَّى: sammā — to name, call (verb II); passive imperf. 3fs tusammā, 'is called'
أَلْفَ: alf — thousand (m., acc. as the retained second object of the passive)
لَيْلَةٍ: لَيْلَة — layla, night (f., gen. sg. as the counted noun after alf)
وَلَيْلَةً: وَ + لَيْلَة — layla, night (f., acc., coordinated with alfa)
فِيهَا: فِي + ـهَا — fī, in + 3fs suffix; 'in them' (referring to the f. pl. tales)
مِنَ: min — from, of, among, than (prep.; the nūn takes the linking vowel -a before the article)
السِّيَرِ: الـ + سِيَر — sīra, life-story, career (f. pl. siyar; gen.)
الْجَلِيلَةِ: الـ + جَلِيلَة — jalīl, noble, majestic, weighty (adj., f. sg. agreeing with a non-human pl., gen.)
وَالْأَمْثَالِ: وَ + الـ + أَمْثَال — mathal, proverb, exemplary saying (m. pl. amthāl; gen.)
فَقَدْ: فَـ + قَدْ — qad, indeed, already (particle before a perfect verb)
حُكِيَ: ḥakā — to relate, recount (verb I defective); passive perf. 3ms ḥukiya, 'it was related'
وَاللَّهُ: وَ + اللَّه — Allāh, God (nom., subject of a parenthetical circumstantial clause)
أَعْلَمُ: aʿlam — more/most knowing (elative of ʿalima; m., nom. as predicate)
بِغَيْبِهِ: بِـ + غَيْب + ـهِ — ghayb, the hidden, the unseen (m., gen.); 'of His unseen'
وَأَحْكَمُ: وَ + أَحْكَم — aḥkam, wiser (elative of ḥakīm)
وَأَعَزُّ: وَ + أَعَزّ — aʿazz, mightier, more exalted (elative of ʿazīz)
وَأَكْرَمُ: وَ + أَكْرَم — akram, more generous, more noble (elative of karīm)
وَأَلْطَفُ: وَ + أَلْطَف — alṭaf, more gracious, more subtly kind (elative of laṭīf)
وَأَرْحَمُ: وَ + أَرْحَم — arḥam, more merciful (elative of raḥīm)
فِيمَا: فِي + مَا — fī, in, concerning + mā, that which; 'concerning what'
مَضَى: maḍā — to pass, elapse, go by (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
وَتَقَدَّمَ: وَ + تَقَدَّمَ — taqaddama, to go before, precede (verb V, perf. 3ms)
وَنُسْلِفُ: وَ + نُسْلِف — aslafa, to send ahead, set forth in advance (verb IV, imperf. 1pl indic.); anomalous here (see note)
مِنْ: min — from, of, among, than (prep.); also explicative, 'consisting of'
أَحَادِيثِ: أَحَادِيث — ḥadīth, account, report (m. pl. aḥādīth; gen.)
أَنَّهُ: أَنَّ + ـهُ — anna, that (subordinating particle) + 3ms pronoun as its grammatical subject; 'that (it was so)'
كَانَ: kāna — to be, to happen; existential 'there was' (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); with a following verb it frames the tense
فِي: fī — in, within, among, at (prep.); before a verbal noun, 'engaged in'
قَدِيمِ: qadīm — old, ancient (adj. used as a noun, m., gen.); qadīm al-zamān = 'olden time'
الزَّمَانِ: الـ + زَمَان — zamān, time, age (m., gen.)
وَسَالِفِ: وَ + سَالِف — sālif, that which is past, bygone (act. part. of salafa; m., gen.)
الْعَصْرِ: الـ + عَصْر — ʿaṣr, era, epoch (m., gen.)
وَالْأَوَانِ: وَ + الـ + أَوَان — awān, time, season, period (m., gen.)
مَلِكٌ: malik — king (m., nom. indef.; the delayed subject of kāna)
مُلُوكِ: مُلُوك — malik, king (m. pl. mulūk; gen.)
بَنِي: بَنِي — banū, sons of, tribe of (m. pl. of ibn; gen. banī in construct)
سَاسَانَ: Sāsān — Sasan, eponym of the Sasanian kings (proper name, diptote: gen. in -a without tanwīn)
بِجَزَائِرِ: بِـ + جَزَائِر — jazīra, island (f. pl. jazāʾir; gen.); bi- here locative, 'in the isles of'
صَاحِبُ: ṣāḥib — companion, possessor, master of (m., nom., in apposition to malikun)
وَأَعْوَانٍ: وَ + أَعْوَان — ʿawn, helper, auxiliary (m. pl. aʿwān; gen. indef.)
وَخَدَمٍ: وَ + خَدَم — khādim, servant (collective pl. khadam; gen. indef.)
وَحَشَمٍ: وَ + حَشَم — ḥasham, retinue, household attendants, entourage (coll.; gen. indef.)
وَكَانَ: وَ + كَانَ — kāna, to be (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); often existential, 'there was/were', and with لِـ + suffix, 'he had'
لَهُ: لِـ + ـهُ — li-, to, for, belonging to (prep.) + 3ms suffix; 'to him, for him'
وَلَدَانِ: وَلَد (dual) — walad, son, child (m. dual nom.); subject of kāna
أَحَدُهُمَا: أَحَد + ـهُمَا — aḥad, one (m., nom.) + 3m dual suffix; 'one of the two'
كَبِيرٌ: kabīr — big, great; here 'elder' (adj., m. nom. indef.)
وَالْآخَرُ: وَ + الـ + آخَر — ākhar, the other (m., nom.)
صَغِيرٌ: ṣaghīr — small, little; here 'younger' (adj., m. nom. indef.)
وَكَانَا: وَ + كَانَ + ـا — kāna, to be (perf. 3m dual); 'and the two were'
فَارِسَيْنِ: فَارِس (dual) — fāris, horseman, knight (m. dual acc. as predicate of kānā)
بَطَلَيْنِ: بَطَل (dual) — baṭal, champion, hero (m. dual acc.)
الْأَكْبَرُ: الـ + أَكْبَر — akbar, greater, elder (elative of kabīr; m., nom.)
أَفْرَسَ: afras — more skilled as a horseman (elative formed from the noun fāris; m., acc. as predicate of kāna; diptote)
الْأَصْغَرِ: الـ + أَصْغَر — aṣghar, smaller, younger (elative of ṣaghīr; m., gen.)
وَقَدْ: وَ + قَدْ — qad, indeed, already (with a perfect verb it gives pluperfect force)
مَلَكَ: malaka — to own, hold, rule over (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْبِلَادَ: الـ + بِلَاد — balad, land, town, territory (m. pl. bilād; acc. as object)
وَحَكَمَ: وَ + حَكَمَ — ḥakama, to judge, govern, pass sentence (verb I, perf. 3ms)
بِالْعَدْلِ: بِـ + الـ + عَدْل — ʿadl, justice, equity (m., gen.); 'with justice'
الرَّعِيَّةِ: الـ + رَعِيَّة — raʿiyya, the subjects, the flock ruled over (f. coll., gen.)
وَأَحَبُّوهُ: وَ + أَحَبُّوا + ـهُ — aḥabba, to love (verb IV doubled, perf. 3mp) + 3ms object suffix; 'and they loved him'
أَهْلُ: ahl — people, folk, inhabitants (m., nom.; the subject following the verb)
بِلَادِهِ: بِلَاد + ـهِ — balad, land, town (m.; broken pl. بِلَاد, taking f. sg. agreement as non-human plurals do; gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'his lands'
وَمَمْلَكَتِهِ: وَ + مَمْلَكَة + ـهِ — mamlaka, kingdom, realm (f., gen.); 'and his kingdom'
اسْمُهُ: اسْم + ـهُ — ism, name (m., nom.); 'his name' (the initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl and is elided in reading)
الْمَلِكَ: الـ + مَلِك — malik, king (m., acc. as predicate of kāna)
شَهْرِيَارَ: Shahriyār — Persian name, roughly 'lord of the realm' (proper name, diptote: acc. in -a without tanwīn)
أَخُوهُ: أَخ + ـهُ — akh, brother (m.; one of the 'five nouns', nom. form أَخُو) + 3ms poss.; 'his brother'
الصَّغِيرُ: الـ + صَغِير — ṣaghīr, small; here 'younger' (adj., m., nom.)
شَاهْ: shāh — king (Persian loanword); indeclinable first element of the name Shāh Zamān, the case falling on زَمَان
زَمَانَ: zamān — time, age (m.); second element of Shāh Zamān, 'king of the age' (acc., diptote as part of a foreign proper name)
مَلِكَ: malik — king (m., acc. as predicate of kāna; first term of an iḍāfa)
سَمَرْقَنْدَ: Samarqand — the city in Transoxiana (proper name, diptote: gen. in -a)
الْعَجَمِ: الـ + عَجَم — ʿajam, the non-Arabs, esp. the Persians (coll., gen.)
وَلَمْ: وَ + لَمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + lam, not (negative particle governing the jussive and negating the past)
يَزَالَا: zāla — to cease (verb I, imperf. jussive 3rd dual, nūn dropped); with lam: 'the two did not cease'
مُسْتَمِرَّيْنِ: mustamirr — continuing, going on (act. part. of istamarra, verb X; dual acc./gen., predicate of lam yazālā)
بِلَادِهِمَا: بِلَاد + ـهِمَا — bilād, lands, country (f. pl. of balad) + 3rd dual poss. suffix; 'their two lands'
وَكُلُّ: وَ + كُلُّ — wa, and (here circumstantial 'with, while') + kull, each, every (m., nom. as subject of a nominal clause)
وَاحِدٍ: wāḥid — one (numeral/noun, m. gen. as second term of the iḍāfa); 'each one'
مَمْلَكَتِهِ: مَمْلَكَة + ـهِ — mamlaka, kingdom, realm (f.) + 3ms poss.; 'his kingdom'
حَاكِمٌ: ḥākim — ruler, governor, one who judges (act. part. of ḥakama, verb I; m. nom. as predicate)
عَادِلٌ: ʿādil — just, equitable (act. part. of ʿadala; m. nom., adjective agreeing with ḥākim)
رَعِيَّتِهِ: رَعِيَّة + ـهِ — raʿiyya, flock, subjects of a ruler (f.) + 3ms poss.; 'his subjects'
مُدَّةَ: mudda — period, span of time (f., acc. as adverb of duration, first term of iḍāfa)
عِشْرِينَ: ʿishrūn — twenty (numeral, oblique form in ـينَ)
سَنَةً: sana — year (f., acc. sing. as the counted noun after 11–99)
غَايَةِ: ghāya — utmost degree, extreme (f., gen. after fī); fī ghāyati X = 'in the utmost of X'
الْبَسْطِ: الـ + بَسْط — basṭ, expansiveness, cheer, good spirits (m., gen.)
وَالِانْشِرَاحِ: وَ + الـ + انْشِرَاح — inshirāḥ, gladness, lightness of heart (verbal noun of insharaḥa, verb VII; m., gen.)
الْحَالَةِ: الـ + حَالَة — ḥāla, state, condition (f., gen. after عَلَى)
فَعِنْدَ: فَـ + عِنْدَ — fa, so, and then (conj.) + ʿinda, at, by (adverbial prep.); ʿinda dhālika = 'at that point'
اشْتَاقَ: ishtāqa — to long for, yearn (verb VIII of shawq, perf. 3ms); construed with ilā
الْمَلِكُ: الـ + مَلِك — malik, king (m., nom. sg., as subject or in apposition)
الْكَبِيرُ: الـ + كَبِير — kabīr, great, elder (adj., m. nom. sg.); 'the elder'
أَخِيهِ: أَخ + ـهِ — akh, brother (m.; one of the 'five nouns', oblique form أَخِي) + 3ms poss.; 'his brother'
الصَّغِيرِ: الـ + صَغِير — ṣaghīr, small, younger (adj., m. gen., agreeing with akhīhi)
فَأَمَرَ: فَـ + أَمَرَ — fa, so (conj.) + amara, to command, order (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَزِيرَهُ: وَزِير + ـهُ — wazīr, vizier, chief minister (m., acc. as object) + 3ms poss.
أَنْ: an — that (subordinating particle governing the subjunctive); after إِلَى it forms 'until'
يُسَافِرَ: sāfara — to travel, set out on a journey (verb III, imperf. subjunctive 3ms after an)
عِنْدِ: ʿinda — at, with, in the presence of (adverbial prep.; gen. عِنْدِ here because إِلَى governs it, as in مِنْ عِنْدِهِ)
وَيُحْضِرَ: وَ + يُحْضِرَ — wa, and + aḥḍara, to bring, cause to be present (verb IV, imperf. subjunctive 3ms, still under an)
بِهِ: بِـ + ـهِ — bi-, with, by, in (prep.) + 3ms suffix; often simply marks the object, 'him'
فَأَجَابَهُ: فَـ + أَجَابَ + ـهُ — ajāba, to answer, reply (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'so he answered him'
بِالسَّمْعِ: بِـ + الـ + سَمْع — samʿ, hearing, hearkening (m., gen. after بِـ); first half of the obedience formula
وَالطَّاعَةِ: وَ + الـ + طَاعَة — ṭāʿa, obedience (f., gen.); second half of the obedience formula
وَسَافَرَ: وَ + سَافَرَ — sāfara, to travel (verb III, perf. 3ms)
وَصَلَ: waṣala — to arrive, reach (verb I, perf. 3ms)
بِالسَّلَامَةِ: بِـ + الـ + سَلَامَة — salāma, safety, soundness (f., gen.); bi-l-salāma = 'safely'
وَدَخَلَ: وَ + دَخَلَ — dakhala, to enter, go in (verb I, perf. 3ms); takes its goal directly or with a preposition
وَبَلَّغَهُ: وَ + بَلَّغَ + ـهُ — ballagha, to convey, deliver (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3ms indir. obj.; 'and he delivered to him'
السَّلَامَ: الـ + سَلَام — salām, greeting, salutation of peace (m., acc. as object)
وَأَعْلَمَهُ: وَ + أَعْلَمَ + ـهُ — aʿlama, to inform, let know (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
أَنَّ: anna — that (particle introducing a nominal clause; its subject takes the accusative)
أَخَاهُ: أَخ + ـهُ — akh, brother (m., acc. 'five nouns' form akhā-) + 3ms poss.; subject of anna
مُشْتَاقٌ: mushtāq — longing, yearning (act. part. of ishtāqa, verb VIII; m. nom. as predicate of anna)
إِلَيْهِ: إِلَى + ـهِ — ilā, to, toward (prep., pre-suffix form ilay-) + 3ms; 'to him, for him'
وَقَصْدَهُ: وَ + قَصْد + ـهُ — qaṣd, aim, intent, purpose (m., acc. as a second subject of anna) + 3ms poss.
بِزِيَارَتِهِ: بِـ + زِيَارَة + ـهِ — ziyāra, visit, visiting (f., verbal noun of zāra; gen. after bi) + 3ms obj. poss.; 'in visiting him'
وَتَجَهَّزَ: وَ + تَجَهَّزَ — tajahhaza, to equip oneself, make ready (verb V, perf. 3ms)
لِلسَّفَرِ: لِـ + الـ + سَفَر — safar, travel, journey (m., gen. after li); 'for the journey'
وَأَخْرَجَ: وَ + أَخْرَجَ — akhraja, to bring out, send forth (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
خِيَامَهُ: خِيَام + ـهُ — khiyām, tents (f. pl. of khayma; acc. as object) + 3ms poss.
وَجِمَالَهُ: وَ + جِمَال + ـهُ — jimāl, camels (pl. of jamal; acc.) + 3ms poss.
وَبِغَالَهُ: وَ + بِغَال + ـهُ — bighāl, mules (pl. of baghl; acc.) + 3ms poss.
وَخَدَمَهُ: وَ + خَدَم + ـهُ — khadam, servants, attendants (collective; acc.) + 3ms poss.
وَأَعْوَانَهُ: وَ + أَعْوَان + ـهُ — aʿwān, helpers, aides, retainers (pl. of ʿawn; acc.) + 3ms poss.
وَأَقَامَ: وَ + أَقَامَ — aqāma, to set up, appoint, install (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
حَاكِمًا: ḥākim — ruler, governor (act. part. of ḥakama; m. acc. as ḥāl / second object); 'as ruler'
وَخَرَجَ: وَ + خَرَجَ — kharaja, to go out, come forth, depart (verb I, perf. 3ms)
طَالِبًا: ṭālib — seeking, making for (act. part. of ṭalaba; m. acc. as ḥāl); 'seeking, bound for'
بِلَادَ: bilād — lands, country (f. pl.; acc. as object of ṭāliban, first term of iḍāfa)
فَلَمَّا: فَـ + لَمَّا — fa-, and so (conj.) + lammā, when, as soon as (temporal particle taking the perfect)
نِصْفِ: niṣf — half, middle (m., gen. after fī, first term of iḍāfa)
اللَّيْلِ: الـ + لَيْل — layl, night (m., gen.); niṣf al-layl = 'midnight'
تَذَكَّرَ: tadhakkara — to remember, call to mind (verb V, perf. 3ms)
حَاجَةً: ḥāja — need, thing needed, errand (f., acc. indef. as object)
نَسِيَهَا: نَسِيَ + ـهَا — nasiya, to forget (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'which he had forgotten'
قَصْرِهِ: قَصْر + ـهِ — qaṣr, palace, castle (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.
فَرَجَعَ: فَـ + رَجَعَ — rajaʿa, to return, go back (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَصْرَهُ: قَصْر + ـهُ — qaṣr, palace (m., acc. as object of dakhala) + 3ms poss.
فَوَجَدَ: فَـ + وَجَدَ — wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 3ms); takes an object plus an accusative complement
زَوْجَتَهُ: زَوْجَة + ـهُ — zawja, wife (f., acc. as object) + 3ms poss.
رَاقِدَةً: rāqida — lying down, asleep (act. part. of raqada; f. acc. as ḥāl)
فِرَاشِهِ: فِرَاش + ـهِ — firāsh, bed, bedding (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.
مُعَانِقَةً: muʿāniqa — embracing, holding in the arms (act. part. of ʿānaqa, verb III; f. acc. as second ḥāl)
عَبْدًا: ʿabd — slave (m., acc. indef.); object of a participle, or tamyīz after a numeral
أَسْوَدَ: aswad — black (adj. of the af ʿal colour pattern; diptote, so acc. without tanwīn)
بَعْضِ: baʿḍ — some, a part of, one of (m., gen.; first term of a construct); مِنْ بَعْضِ = 'one of'
الْعَبِيدِ: الـ + عَبِيد — ʿabd (broken pl. عَبِيد), slave (m., gen. pl.); 'the slaves'
رَأَى: raʾā — to see, behold (verb I, perf. 3ms, final-weak)
هَذَا: hādhā — this (dem. pron., m. sg., invariable in form)
الْأَمْرَ: الـ + أَمْر — amr, matter, affair, thing (m., acc. as object of raʾā)
اسْوَدَّتِ: iswadda — to turn black, blacken (verb IX, the colour form, perf. 3fs); final kasra is liaison before the article
الدُّنْيَا: الـ + دُنْيَا — dunyā, the world, this lower world (f., nom. as subject; indeclinable in ā)
وَجْهِهِ: وَجْه + ـهِ — wajh, face (m., gen. after fī) + 3ms poss.; 'his face'
وَقَالَ: وَ + قَالَ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and he said'
نَفْسِهِ: نَفْس + ـهِ — nafs, self, soul (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.; فِي نَفْسِهِ = 'within himself, inwardly'
الْأَمْرُ: الـ + أَمْر — amr, matter, affair (m., nom. as subject of kāna)
قَدْ: qad — particle before the perfect marking completion; 'already, indeed'
وَقَعَ: waqaʿa — to fall, occur, come to pass (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَأَنَا: وَ + أَنَا — wa, here circumstantial 'while' + anā, I (1st sing. independent pronoun)
مَا: mā — (1) what, that which (rel. pron.); (2) not (negative particle before a perfect verb, a Middle Arabic usage where Classical prose has lam)
فَارَقْتُ: fāraqa — to part from, leave (verb III, perf. 1st sing.); 'I have left'
الْمَدِينَةَ: الـ + مَدِينَة — madīna, city (f., acc. as object)
فَكَيْفَ: فَـ + كَيْفَ — fa, then (apodosis marker) + kayfa, how (interrogative)
حَالُ: ḥāl — state, condition, case (m./f., nom. as subject, first term of iḍāfa)
الْمَلْعُونَةِ: الـ + مَلْعُونَة — malʿūna, accursed woman, damned one (pass. part. of laʿana; f., gen.)
لَمَّا: lammā — when (temporal particle; here with the imperfect for future time)
أَغِيبُ: ghāba — to be absent, be away (verb I, imperf. 1st sing., hollow); 'I am away'
عِنْدَ: ʿinda — at, with, in the presence of (adverbial prep.; acc. عِنْدَ, gen. عِنْدِ when another preposition governs it)
أَخِي: أَخ + ـي — akh, brother (m.; 'five nouns' form) + 1st sg. poss.; 'my brother', here vocative
مُدَّةً: mudda — a period, a space of time (f., acc. indef. as adverb of duration)
إِنَّهُ: إِنَّ + ـهُ — inna, indeed, verily (particle taking an accusative subject) + 3ms suffix, here a dummy pronoun; ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ is simply a narrative 'then'
سَحَبَ: saḥaba — to draw, drag, pull out (verb I, perf. 3ms)
سَيْفَهُ: سَيْف + ـهُ — sayf, sword (m., acc. as object) + 3ms poss.
وَضَرَبَ: وَ + ضَرَبَ — ḍaraba, to strike, smite (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الِاثْنَيْنِ: الـ + اثْنَيْنِ — ithnān, two, the pair (numeral; oblique/acc. dual form with hamzat waṣl); 'the two of them'
وَقَتَلَهُمَا: وَ + قَتَلَ + ـهُمَا — qatala, to kill, slay (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3rd dual obj.; 'and he killed them both'
الْفِرَاشِ: الـ + فِرَاش — firāsh, bed, bedding (m., gen. after fī)
وَرَجَعَ: وَ + رَجَعَ — rajaʿa, to return, go back (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَقْتِهِ: وَقْت + ـهِ — waqt, time, moment (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.
وَسَاعَتِهِ: وَ + سَاعَة + ـهِ — sāʿa, hour, instant (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.; the doublet means 'that same instant'
وَأَمَرَ: وَ + أَمَرَ — amara, to command, order (verb I, perf. 3ms); with bi, 'to give orders for'
بِالرَّحِيلِ: بِـ + الـ + رَحِيل — raḥīl, departure, breaking camp, setting out (m., gen. after bi)
وَسَارَ: وَ + سَارَ — sāra, to travel, journey, set off (verb I, perf. 3ms); wa-, and
مَدِينَةِ: madīna — city (f.); genitive as first term of a construct
قَرُبَ: qaruba — to be near, draw near (verb I, perf. 3ms)
مَدِينَتَهُ: مَدِينَة + ـهُ — madīna, city (f.), accusative; 'his city'
الْمُبَشِّرِينَ: الـ + مُبَشِّرِين — mubashshir, bringer of good news, herald (act. part. II of بشّر); sound m. pl., accusative
بِقُدُومِهِ: بِـ + قُدُوم + ـهِ — qudūm, arrival, coming (m., verbal noun); 'with (the news of) his arrival'
فَخَرَجَ: فَـ + خَرَجَ — kharaja, to go out, come forth (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَلَاقَاهُ: وَ + لَاقَى + ـهُ — lāqā, to meet, encounter (verb III, perf. 3ms); 'and he met him'
وَفَرِحَ: وَ + فَرِحَ — fariḥa, to rejoice, be glad (verb I, perf. 3ms); with بِـ at what
غَايَةَ: ghāya — utmost degree, extreme (f.); adverbial accusative, first term of a construct
الْفَرَحِ: الـ + فَرَح — faraḥ, joy, gladness (m., verbal noun); genitive
وَزَيَّنَ: وَ + زَيَّنَ — zayyana, to adorn, decorate (verb II, perf. 3ms)
وَجَلَسَ: وَ + جَلَسَ — jalasa, to sit, sit down (verb I, perf. 3ms)
مَعَهُ: مَعَ + ـهُ — maʿa, with (prep. of accompaniment); 'with him'
يَتَحَدَّثُ: yataḥaddathu — to talk, converse (verb V, impf. 3ms); circumstantial
وَيَنْشَرِحُ: وَ + يَنْشَرِحُ — insharaḥa, to be expanded, be gladdened, take delight (verb VII, impf. 3ms); lit. 'his breast is opened'
فَتَذَكَّرَ: فَـ + تَذَكَّرَ — tadhakkara, to remember, call to mind (verb V, perf. 3ms)
زَمَانُ: zamān — time, age (m.); second element of Shāh Zamān, 'king of the age' (nom. as subject; diptote, so -u without tanwīn)
أَمْرِ: amr — affair, matter, business (m.); genitive after مِنْ
فَحَصَلَ: فَـ + حَصَلَ — ḥaṣala, to come about, occur, befall (verb I, perf. 3ms)
عِنْدَهُ: عِنْدَ + ـهُ — ʿinda, at, with, in the possession of (prep.); 'with him', i.e. he felt it
غَمٌّ: ghamm — grief, distress, gloom (m.); nominative indefinite subject
زَايِدٌ: zāyid (Class. zāʾid) — increasing, excessive (act. part. I of زاد); adjective agreeing with غَمّ
وَاصْفَرَّ: وَ + اصْفَرَّ — iṣfarra, to turn yellow, grow sallow (verb IX, perf. 3ms)
لَوْنُهُ: لَوْن + ـهُ — lawn, colour, complexion (m., nom. sg.) + 3ms suffix; 'his colour'
وَضَعُفَ: وَ + ضَعُفَ — ḍaʿufa, to become weak (verb I, perf. 3ms)
جِسْمُهُ: جِسْم + ـهُ — jism, body (m.); 'his body', nominative subject
رَآهُ: رَأَى + ـهُ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms, defective); 'he saw him'
ظَنَّ: ẓanna — to think, suppose, surmise (verb I, perf. 3ms, doubled)
بِسَبَبِ: بِـ + سَبَب — sabab, cause, reason (m.); 'by reason of, because of'
مُفَارَقَتِهِ: مُفَارَقَة + ـهِ — mufāraqa, parting-from, separation (f., verbal noun III); 'his parting from'
بِلَادَهُ: بِلَاد + ـهُ — bilād, lands, country (f. pl. of بَلَد); accusative object of the verbal noun; 'his lands'
وَمُلْكَهُ: وَ + مُلْك + ـهُ — mulk, kingship, dominion, realm (m.); accusative; 'and his kingdom'
فَتَرَكَ: فَـ + تَرَكَ — taraka, to leave, let be, abandon (verb I, perf. 3ms)
سَبِيلَهُ: سَبِيل + ـهُ — sabīl, path, way (m.); accusative; in the idiom تَرَكَ سَبِيلَهُ, 'he left him to himself'
يَسْأَلْ: yasʾal — saʾala, to ask, inquire (verb I, impf. jussive 3ms after لَمْ)
الْأَيَّامِ: الـ + أَيَّام — yawm, day (m.), pl. أَيَّام; 'the days', hence 'on a certain day'
قَٰلَ: قَالَ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); the edition prints قل without the alif, so the ā is written here with a dagger alif
إِنِّي: إِنَّ + ـي — inna, verily (particle) + 1st-person suffix; 'indeed I'
أَرَاكَ: أَرَى + ـكَ — raʾā, to see (verb I, impf. 1sg أَرَى) + 2ms object; 'I see you'
ضَعُفَ: ḍaʿufa — to become weak (verb I, perf. 3ms)
جِسْمُكَ: جِسْم + ـكَ — jism, body (m.); 'your body' (2ms), nominative subject
لَوْنُكَ: لَوْن + ـكَ — lawn, colour, complexion (m., nom. sg.) + 2ms suffix; 'your colour'
فَقَالَ: فَـ + قَالَ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'so he said'
أَنَا: anā — I (independent pron., 1sg); fronted as topic
بَاطِنِي: بَاطِن + ـي — bāṭin, inward part, interior (m., act. part. I of بطن); 'my inside'
جُرْحٌ: jurḥ — wound, gash (m.); nominative indefinite, the comment of the sentence
يُخْبِرْهُ: يُخْبِرْ + ـهُ — akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, impf. jussive 3ms after لَمْ) + 3ms object; 'he told him'
بِمَا: بِـ + مَا — bi-, of, about (prep.) + mā, what, that which (relative pron.)
رَأَى: raʾā — to see, behold (verb I, perf. 3ms, final-weak)
أُرِيدُ: urīdu — arāda, to want, wish (verb IV, impf. 1sg)
تُسَافِرَ: tusāfira — sāfara, to travel, set out on a journey (verb III, impf. subjunctive 2ms)
مَعِي: مَعَ + ـي — maʿa, with (prep. of accompaniment); 'with me'
الصَّيْدِ: الـ + صَيْد — ṣayd, hunting, the chase, game (m., verbal noun; gen. after إِلَى)
وَالْقَنْصِ: وَ + الـ + قَنْص — qanṣ, hunting, catching of game (m., verbal noun); near-synonym paired with صَيْد
لَعَلَّ: laʿalla — perhaps, may it be that (particle of hoping)
يَنْشَرِحَ: yanshariḥa — insharaḥa, to be expanded, be cheered (verb VII, impf. subjunctive 3ms)
خَاطِرُكَ: خَاطِر + ـكَ — khāṭir, mind, heart, spirits (m., act. part. I of خطر); 'your mind', nominative subject
فَأَبَى: فَـ + أَبَى — abā, to refuse, decline (verb I, perf. 3ms, defective)
فَسَافَرَ: فَـ + سَافَرَ — sāfara, to travel, set out (verb III, perf. 3ms)
أَخُوةُ: أَخ + ـهُ (written ة) — akh, brother (m.), nominative أَخُو + 3ms suffix; 'his brother'
وَحْدَةُ: وَحْد + ـهُ (written ة) — waḥd, aloneness (m.); adverbial accusative waḥdahu, 'by himself, alone'
قَصْرِ: qaṣr — palace, castle (m.); genitive after فِي, first term of a construct
الْمَلِكِ: الـ + مَلِك — malik, king (m., gen. sg., alone or in apposition)
شَبَابِيكُ: shubbāk, window, lattice (m.), broken pl. شَبَابِيك — diptote, so nominative without tanwīn; subject of كَانَ
تُطِلُّ: tuṭillu — aṭalla ʿalā, to look out over, overlook (verb IV, impf. 3fs, doubled); f. sg. agreeing with a non-human plural
بُسْتَانِ: bustān — garden, orchard (m., from Persian); genitive after عَلَى
فَنَظَرَ: فَـ + نَظَرَ — naẓara, to look, gaze (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَإِذَا: وَ + إِذَا — idhā, particle of sudden discovery; 'and behold, and all at once'
بِبَابِ: بِـ + بَاب — bāb, gate, door (m., gen. sg. in construct after bi-); 'at the gate of'
الْقَصْرِ: الـ + قَصْر — qaṣr, palace, castle (m., gen. sg.); 'the palace'
انْفَتَحَ: infataḥa, to open, be opened (verb VII, perf. 3ms); 'it opened'
مِنْهُ: مِنْ + ـهُ — min, from + 3ms suffix; 'from it'
عِشْرُونَ: ʿishrūna, twenty (nom. of the sound-plural type numeral)
جَارِيَةً: jāriya, slave-girl, handmaid (f., acc. sg. as tamyīz after the numeral)
وَامْرَأَةُ: وَ + امْرَاَة — imraʾa, woman, wife (f., nom. sg. in construct; initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl, so read wa-mraʾatu); 'and the wife of'
تَمْشِي: mashā, to walk, go on foot (verb I, impf. 3fs); 'she walks, walking'
بَيْنَهُمْ: بَيْنَ + ـهُمْ — bayna, between, among + 3mp suffix; 'among them'
وَهِيَ: وَ + هِيَ — hiya, she (indep. pron. 3fs), here opening a circumstantial clause; 'she being'
بَدِيعَةُ: badīʿ (f. badīʿa), marvellous, exquisite (f. nom. sg. in construct); 'marvellous of'
الْحُسْنِ: الـ + حُسْن — ḥusn, beauty, goodliness (m., gen. sg.)
وَالْجَمَالِ: وَ + الـ + جَمَال — jamāl, beauty, comeliness (m., gen. sg.)
حَتَّى: ḥattā — until (temporal, with the perfect); so that (purposive, with the subjunctive)
وَصَلُوا: waṣala, to arrive, reach (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they arrived'
فِسْقِيَّةٍ: fisqiyya, fountain-basin, ornamental pool (f., gen. sg. indef.)
وَخَلَعُوا: وَ + خَلَعَ — khalaʿa, to take off, cast off (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they cast off'
ثِيَابَهُمْ: ثِيَاب + ـهُمْ — thawb (pl. thiyāb), garment (m., acc. pl.) + 3mp suffix; 'their garments'
وَجَلَسُوا: وَ + جَلَسَ — jalasa, to sit down (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they sat down'
بِامْرَأَةِ: بِـ + امْرَاَة — imraʾa, woman, wife (f., gen. sg. in construct; initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl, read bi-mraʾati); 'there was the wife of'
صَاحَتْ: ṣāḥa, to cry out, shout (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); 'she cried out'
مَسْعُودُ: Masʿūd, proper name (m., nom. as vocative; literally 'fortunate')
فَجَاءَهَا: فَـ + جَاءَ + ـهَا — jāʾa, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs suffix; 'so there came to her'
أَسْوَدُ: aswad, black (adj. of colour, m. nom. sg., diptote)
فَعَانَقَهَا: فَـ + عَانَقَ + ـهَا — ʿānaqa, to embrace (verb III, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'so he embraced her'
وَعَانَقَتْهُ: وَ + عَانَقَتْ + ـهُ — ʿānaqa, to embrace (verb III, perf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.; 'and she embraced him'
وَوَاقَعَهَا: وَ + وَاقَعَ + ـهَا — wāqaʿa, to lie with, have intercourse with (verb III, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'and he lay with her'
وَكَذَلِكَ: وَ + كَـ + ذَلِكَ — kadhālika, thus, likewise, in the same way
الْجَوَارِي: الـ + جَوَارِي — jāriya (pl. jawārī), slave-girl, handmaid (f., pl., here fronted as topic)
فَعَلُوا: faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they did'
بِهِمُ: بِـ + ـهِمْ — bi-, with + 3mp suffix (masc. used for the feminine slave-girls); 'with them'
الْعَبِيدُ: الـ + عَبِيد — ʿabd (pl. ʿabīd), slave (m., nom. pl., subject of faʿalū); 'the slaves'
يَزَالُوا: zāla (mā/lam yazal), to cease (verb I hollow, jussive 3mp); with lam: 'they did not cease'
بَوْسٍ: baws, kissing (verbal noun of bāsa, m., gen. sg. indef.)
وَعِنَاقٍ: وَ + عِنَاق — ʿināq, embracing (verbal noun of ʿānaqa, verb III, m., gen. sg. indef.)
وَنَيْكٍ: وَ + نَيْك — nayk, fucking (verbal noun of nāka, verb I; obscene register, m., gen. sg. indef.)
وَرِحَاقٍ: وَ + رِحَاق — riḥāq, obscure and probably corrupt form as printed (fiʿāl pattern like ʿināq/siḥāq); expected sense in this list is siḥāq, tribadism (gen. sg. indef.)
وَلَّى: wallā, to appoint, install in office (verb II, perf. 3ms); the standing idiom wallā wa-ʿazala, 'appointed and dismissed', for a ruler's ordinary business of state
النَّهَارُ: الـ + نَهَار — nahār, day, daytime (m., nom. sg.)
أَخُو: akh, brother (m., one of the 'five nouns', nom. in -ū in construct); 'the brother of'
قَالَ: qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'he said'
وَاللَّهِ: وَ + اللَّه — wa-Allāhi, 'by God' (the wāw of oath, wāw al-qasam, governing the genitive)
إِنَّ: inna, verily, truly (emphatic particle governing the accusative)
بَلِيَّتِي: بَلِيَّة + ـي — baliyya, affliction, calamity, trial (f., acc. after inna) + 1s suffix; 'my affliction'
أَخَفُّ: akhaff, lighter, less grievous (elative of khafīf, m. nom. sg.)
الْبَلِيَّةِ: الـ + بَلِيَّة — baliyya, affliction, calamity (f., gen. sg.)
وَقَدِ: وَ + قَدْ — qad, perfective particle 'already, indeed' (with linking vowel -i before hamzat al-waṣl)
انْفَكَّ: infakka, to be loosed, undone, released (verb VII, perf. 3ms); 'has been loosed'
عِنْدَكَ: عِنْدَ + ـكَ — ʿinda, with, in the keeping of + 2ms suffix; 'with you'
الْغَيْرِ: الـ + غَيْر — ghayr (here for ghayra), jealousy (m., gen. sg.)
وَالْغَمِّ: وَ + الـ + غَمّ — ghamm, grief, distress, gloom (m., gen. sg.)
أَعْظَمُ: aʿẓam, greater, graver (elative of ʿaẓīm, m. nom. sg.)
مِمَّا: مِنْ + مَا — min + mā, 'than that which'
لِي: لِـ + ـي — li-, to + 1s suffix; 'to me'
يَزَلْ: zāla (mā/lam yazal), to cease (verb I hollow, jussive 3ms); with lam: 'he did not cease'
أَكْلٍ: akl, eating (verbal noun of akala, m., gen. sg. indef.)
وَشُرْبٍ: وَ + شُرْب — shurb, drinking (verbal noun of shariba, m., gen. sg. indef.)
وَبَعْدَ: وَ + بَعْدَ — baʿda, after (prep. governing the genitive)
السَّفَرِ: الـ + سَفَر — safar, journey, travel (m., gen. sg.)
فَسَلَّمَا: فَـ + سَلَّمَ + ـا — sallama (ʿalā), to greet, salute (verb II, perf. 3m dual); 'so the two saluted'
بَعْضِهِمَا: بَعْض + ـهِمَا — baʿḍ, some, part (m., gen. sg.) + 3m dual suffix; idiomatically 'one another'
وَنَظَرَ: وَ + نَظَرَ — naẓara (ilā), to look (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he looked'
شَهْرِيَارُ: Shahriyār, proper name (m., nom.; Persian, 'lord of the realm')
شَاهْزَمَانَ: Shāhzamān, proper name (m., diptote, gen. in -a; Persian, 'king of the age')
رَآةُ: رَآ + ـةُ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object suffix ـهُ, printed as tāʾ marbūṭa; 'he saw him'
رُدَّ: radda, to give back, restore (verb I doubled, passive perf. 3ms); 'was given back'
وَاحْمَرَّ: وَ + احْمَرَّ — iḥmarra, to turn red, grow ruddy (verb IX, perf. 3ms)
وَجْهُهُ: وَجْه + ـهُ — wajh, face (m., nom. sg.) + 3ms suffix; 'his face'
وَصَارَ: وَ + صَارَ — ṣāra, to become, come to be (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms, with following impf.); 'and he took to'
يَأْكُلُ: أَكَلَ — akala, to eat (verb I, impf. 3ms yaʾkulu); the edition prints ياكل without a hamza seat
بِشَهِيَّهْ: بِـ + شَهِيَّة — shahiyya, appetite, relish (f.; the edition prints final ه for ة); 'with appetite'
قَلِيلَ: qalīl, little, scant (adj., m. acc. sg. in construct, predicate of kāna); 'scant of'
الْأَكْلِ: الـ + اَكْل — akl, eating (verbal noun of akala, m., gen. sg.)
كُنْتُ: kāna, to be (verb I hollow, perf. 1s); with a following imperfect: 'I used to'
مُصْفَرَّ: muṣfarr, turned yellow, sallow, wan (act. part. of iṣfarra, verb IX; m. acc. sg. in construct)
اللَّوْنِ: الـ + لَوْن — lawn, colour, complexion (m., gen. sg.)
وَالْوَجْهِ: وَ + الـ + وَجْه — wajh, face, countenance (m., gen. sg.)
وَالْآنَ: وَ + الـ + اَن — al-āna, now (adverbial accusative; the edition prints alif without madda)
إِلَيْكَ: اِلَى + ـكَ — ilā, to + 2ms suffix; 'to you'
فَأَخْبِرْنِي: فَـ + اَخْبِرْ + ـنِي — akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, imper. 2ms) + 1s object suffix; 'so tell me'
بِحَالِكَ: بِـ + حَال + ـكَ — ḥāl, state, condition (gen. sg.) + 2ms suffix; 'of your state'
أَمَّا: ammā, as for, as to (topic particle, answered by fa-)
تَغَيُّرُ: taghayyur, change, alteration (verbal noun of taghayyara, verb V; m., nom. sg. in construct)
لَوْنِي: لَوْن + ـي — lawn, colour, complexion (m.) + 1s suffix; 'my colour'
فَأَذْكُرُهُ: فَـ + اَذْكُرُ + ـهُ — dhakara, to mention, relate (verb I, impf. 1s) + 3ms object suffix; 'then I relate it'
لَكَ: لِـ + ـكَ — li-, to + 2ms suffix; 'to you'
وَاعْفُ: وَ + اعْفُ — ʿafā (ʿafā ʿan), to pardon, excuse, let off (verb I defective, imper. 2ms); 'and excuse'
عَنِّي: عَنْ + ـي — ʿan, from, concerning + 1s suffix; 'me'
إِخْبَارِي: اِخْبَار + ـي — ikhbār, informing, telling (verbal noun of akhbara, verb IV; gen. sg.) + 1s suffix; 'my informing'
بِرَدِّ: بِـ + رَدّ — radd, giving back, restoration (verbal noun of radda; gen. sg. in construct); 'of the giving-back of'
أَخْبِرْنِي: اَخْبِرْ + ـنِي — akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, imper. 2ms) + 1s object suffix; 'tell me'
أَوَّلًا: awwal, first (adverbial accusative with tanwīn); 'first of all'
بِتَغَيُّرِ: بِـ + تَغَيُّر — taghayyur, change, alteration (verbal noun of taghayyara, verb V; gen. sg. in construct)
لَوْنِكَ: لَوْن + ـكَ — lawn, colour, complexion (m., gen. sg.) + 2ms suffix; 'your colour'
وَضَعْفِكَ: وَ + ضَعْف + ـكَ — ḍaʿf, weakness, feebleness (m., gen. sg.) + 2ms suffix; 'and your weakness'
أَسْمَعَهُ: اَسْمَعَ + ـهُ — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, subjunctive 1s after ḥattā) + 3ms object suffix; 'that I may hear it'
اعْلَمْ: ʿalima, to know (verb I, imper. 2ms; the initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl, elided in reading); 'know!'
أَنِّي: أَنَّ + ـِي — anna, that (particle after a verb of knowing, taking the acc.) + 1cs pronoun as its subject; 'that I'
أَرْسَلَتَ: arsala, to send (verb IV, perf. 2ms); 'you sent'
وَزِيرَكَ: وَزِير + ـكَ — wazīr, vizier, chief minister (m., acc. as object) + 2ms poss.
إِلَيَّ: إِلَى + ـِي — ilā, to, toward (prep., contracted with the 1cs suffix); 'to me'
يَطْلُبُنِي: طَلَبَ + ـنِي — ṭalaba, to seek, demand (verb I, imperf. 3ms, circumstantial) + 1cs obj.; 'seeking me'
لِلْحُضُورِ: لِـ + الـ + حُضُور — ḥuḍūr, presence, attendance (m., verbal noun of ḥaḍara; gen.); 'for the presence'
بَيْنَ: bayna — between (prep.); بَيْنَ يَدَيْ = 'before, in the presence of'
يَدَيْكَ: يَد (dual, oblique) + ـكَ — yad, hand (f. dual) + 2ms poss.; 'your two hands' (idiom: before you)
جَهَّزْتُ: jahhaza, to make ready, equip (verb II, perf. 1cs); 'I made ready'
حَالِي: حَال + ـِي — ḥāl, state, condition (m./f.) + 1cs poss.; 'my state'
بَرَزْتُ: baraza, to go forth, emerge (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I had gone forth'
بَرَّ: barra — outside of, without the walls of (adv. acc. of barr, open country); 'outside'
مَدِينَتِي: مَدِينَة + ـِي — madīna, city (f.) + 1cs poss.; 'my city'
تَذَكَّرْتُ: tadhakkara, to remember, recall (verb V, perf. 1cs); 'I remembered'
الْخَرَزَةَ: الـ + خَرَزَة — kharaza, bead (f., acc.); 'the bead(-necklace)'
أَعْطَيْتُهَا: أَعْطَى + ـهَا — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 3fs obj.; 'I give it, I have given it'
قَصْرِي: قَصْر + ـِي — qaṣr, palace (m.) + 1cs poss.; 'my palace'
فَرَجَعْتُ: فَـ + رَجَعْتُ — rajaʿa, to return (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'so I returned'
فَوَجَدْتُ: فَـ + وَجَدْتُ — wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'so I found'
زَوْجَتِي: زَوْجَة + ـِي — zawja, wife (f.) + 1cs poss.; 'my wife'
مَعَهَا: مَعَ + ـهَا — maʿa, with (prep.) + 3fs suffix; 'with her'
وَهُوَ: وَ + هُوَ — wa, and + huwa, he (pron.)
نَائِمٌ: nāʾim — sleeping, lying asleep (act. part. of nāma; m. nom. indef.; the edition already prints the hamza-seat ئ here)
فِرَاشِي: فِرَاش + ـِي — firāsh, bed, bedding (m.) + 1cs poss.; 'my bed'
فَقَتَلْتُهُمَا: فَـ + قَتَلْتُ + ـهُمَا — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3m dual obj.; 'so I killed the two of them'
وَجِئْتُ: وَ + جِئْتُ — jāʾa, to come (verb I hamzated, perf. 1cs; the edition already prints the hamza seat ئ); 'and I came'
مُتَفَكِّرٌ: mutafakkir — reflecting, pondering (act. part. of V tafakkara; m. nom. indef.)
الْأَمْرِ: الـ + أَمْر — amr, matter, affair (m., gen.); the edition prints this without the hamza seat (الامر), supplied here as a combining mark
فَهَذَا: فَـ + هَذَا — fa-, so + hādhā, this; 'so this'
سَبَبُ: sabab — cause, reason (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
تَغَيُّرِ: taghayyur — changing, alteration (verbal noun of V taghayyara; m., gen.)
وَضَعْفِي: وَ + ضَعْف + ـِي — ḍaʿf, weakness (m.) + 1cs poss.; 'and my weakness'
وَأَمَّا: wa-ammā — and as for (particle opening a topic-comment clause)
رَدُّ: radd — a giving-back, restoring (verbal noun of radda; m., nom.)
فَاعْفُ: فَـ + اعْفُ — ʿafā (ʿan), to pardon, excuse (verb I defective, imper. 2ms; wasl-hamza); 'then excuse'
أَذْكُرَهُ: ذَكَرَ + ـهُ — dhakara, to mention, relate (verb I, imperf. 1cs subjunctive) + 3ms obj.; 'that I mention it'
كَلَامَهُ: كَلَام + ـهُ — kalām, speech, words (m., acc.) + 3ms poss.; 'his words'
أَقْسَمْتُ: aqsama, to swear, take an oath (verb IV, perf. 1cs); 'I have sworn'
عَلَيْكَ: عَلَى + ـكَ — ʿalā, upon (prep.) + 2ms suffix; here 'I adjure you'
بِالْلَّهِ: بِـ + اللَّه — Allāh, God (gen. after bi-); 'by God' (the alif of the divine name is kept, as the edition prints it here)
إِلَّا: illā — (1) except, only (restrictive particle after a negative); (2) after an oath, marks an insistent demand, 'you must'
أَخْبَرْتَنِي: أَخْبَرَ + ـتَ + ـنِي — akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, perf. 2ms) + 1cs obj.; 'you inform me'
رَدِّ: radd — a giving-back, restoring (verbal noun of radda; m., gen.)
فَأَخْبَرَهُ: فَـ + أَخْبَرَ + ـهُ — akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'so he told him'
جَمِيعَ: jamīʿ — all, the whole of (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
لِأَخِيهِ: لِـ + أَخ + ـِيهِ — li-, to (prep.) + akh, brother (m., 'five nouns', oblique form) + 3ms poss.; 'to his brother'
مُرَادِي: مُرَاد + ـِي — murād, that which is wished, desire (pass. part. of arāda used as a noun, m.) + 1cs poss.; 'my desire, what I want'
أَنْظُرَ: naẓara, to look, see (verb I, imperf. 1cs subjunctive, the particle أَنْ being understood after مُرَادِي); 'that I may see'
بِعَيْنِي: بِـ + عَيْن + ـِي — ʿayn, eye (f.) + 1cs poss.; 'with my (own) eye'
شَاهْزَمَانُ: Shāhzamān — the younger king's name (nom., here as subject)
اجْعَلْ: jaʿala, to make, render, pretend (verb I, imper. 2ms; wasl-hamza, elided in reading); 'make out, pretend'
أَنَّكَ: أَنَّ + ـكَ — anna, that (particle, acc.) + 2ms pronoun as its subject; 'that you'
مُسَافِرٌ: musāfir — traveling, a traveler (act. part. of III sāfara; m. nom. indef.)
لِلصَّيْدِ: لِـ + الـ + صَيْد — ṣayd, hunting, the chase (m., gen.); 'for the hunt'
وَاخْتَفِ: وَ + اخْتَفِ — ikhtafā, to hide oneself (verb VIII, imper. 2ms; wasl-hamza); 'and hide'
عِنْدِي: عِنْدَ + ـِي — ʿinda, at, with (adv.) + 1cs suffix; 'with me, at my side'
وَأَنْتَ: وَ + أَنْتَ — wa, while (circumstantial) + anta, you (pron.)
تُشَاهِدُ: shāhada, to witness, observe (verb III, imperf. 2ms); 'you watch, witness'
وَتَتَحَقَّقُهُ: وَ + تَتَحَقَّقُ + ـهُ — taḥaqqaqa, to ascertain, verify, make sure of (verb V, imperf. 2ms) + 3ms obj.; 'and verify it'
عِيَانًا: ʿiyānan — with (one's own) eyes, by direct sight (m., acc. as adverb)
فَنَادَى: فَـ + نَادَى — nādā, to call out, proclaim (verb III, perf. 3ms); 'then he proclaimed'
سَاعَتِهِ: سَاعَة + ـهِ — sāʿa, hour, moment (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'his hour'
بِالسَّفَرِ: بِـ + الـ + سَفَر — safar, journey, travel (m., gen.); 'for the journey'
فَخَرَجَتِ: فَـ + خَرَجَتْ — kharaja, to go out (verb I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the following non-human plural subject); 'so there went out'
الْعَسَاكِرُ: الـ + عَسَاكِر — ʿaskar, troop, army (m., broken pl. ʿasākir; nom.)
وَالْخِيَامُ: وَ + الـ + خِيَام — khiyām, tents (f. pl. of khayma; nom.)
ظَاهِرِ: ẓāhir — outer part, exterior (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); ẓāhir al-madīna = 'the outskirts of the city'
الْخِيَامِ: الـ + خِيَام — khiyām, tents (f. pl.; gen.)
لِغِلْمَانِهِ: لِـ + غِلْمَان + ـهِ — ghulām, young servant, page (m. pl. ghilmān; gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'to his servants'
لَا: lā — not, no (neg. particle; with the jussive, prohibitive)
يَدْخُلْ: dakhala, to enter (verb I, imperf. 3ms jussive after lā); 'let ... enter'
عَلَيَّ: عَلَى + ـِي — ʿalā, upon (prep.) + 1cs suffix (contracted ʿalayya); 'in to me'
تَنَكَّرَ: tanakkara — to disguise oneself (verb V, perf. 3ms)
مُخْتَفِيًا: mukhtafī — hidden, in secret, in disguise (act. part. of VIII ikhtafā; m. acc. as ḥāl)
الَّذِي: alladhī — who, which (rel. pron., m. sg.)
فِيهِ: فِي + ـهِ — fī, in (prep.) + 3ms suffix; 'in which'
الشُبَّاكِ: الـ + شُبَّاك — shubbāk, window, lattice (m., gen.)
الْمُطِلِّ: الـ + مُطِلّ — muṭill, overlooking (act. part. of IV aṭalla; m. gen.)
سَاعَةً: sāʿatan — an hour, a while (f., acc. of duration)
وَالْجَوَارِي: وَ + الـ + جَوَارِي — jāriya, slave-girl, handmaiden (f. pl. jawārī; nom.)
وَسِتُّهُمْ: وَ + سِتّ + ـهُمْ — sitt, lady, mistress (colloquial f. word, standing for Classical sayyida; nom.) + 3mp poss.; 'and their mistress'
وَفَعَلُوا: وَ + فَعَلُوا — faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they did'
كَمَا: ka-mā — as, just as (prep. + rel. pron.)
أَذَانِ: adhān — the call (to prayer) (m., verbal noun of IV; gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
عَقْلُهُ: عَقْل + ـهُ — ʿaql, mind, reason (m., nom.) + 3ms poss.; 'his mind'
رَأْسِهِ: رَأْس + ـهِ — raʾs, head (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'his head' (the edition prints this without the hamza seat, راسه, supplied here as a combining mark)
قُمْ: qāma — to rise, get up (verb I hollow, imper. 2ms); with بِنَا, 'come on, let's be off'
بِنَا: بِـ + ـنَا — bi-, with (prep.) + 1pl suffix; قُمْ بِنَا = 'arise with us, come along'
نُسَافِرْ: sāfara, to travel (verb III, imperf. 1pl jussive, cohortative after qum); 'let us travel'
حَالِنَا: حَال + ـنَا — ḥāl, state, condition (m./f.) + 1pl poss.; 'our state'
وَلَا: وَ + لَا — wa, and + lā, not, there is no (neg. particle)
لَنَا: لِـ + ـنَا — li-, to, for (prep.) + 1pl suffix; 'to us, we have'
بِالْمُلْكِ: بِـ + الـ + مُلْك — mulk, kingship, dominion (m., gen.); 'of the kingdom'
نَنْظُرَ: naẓara, to see, find (verb I, imperf. 1pl subjunctive after ḥattā); 'until we find'
مِثْلُنَا: مِثْل + ـنَا — mithl, like, equal (m., nom.) + 1pl poss.; 'our like'
وَإِلَّا: وَ + إِلَّا — wa-illā, and if not, otherwise
مَوْتُنَا: مَوْت + ـنَا — mawt, death (m., nom.) + 1pl poss.; 'our death'
خَيْرٌ: khayr — better (elative used as adj., m. nom. indef.)
حَيَاتِنَا: حَيَاة + ـنَا — ḥayāh, life (f., gen.) + 1pl poss.; 'our life'
إِنَّهُمَا: إِنَّ + هُمَا — inna, indeed (particle, puts its subject in the acc.) + 3md pronoun; 'indeed the two of them' (narrative connective, cf. ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ)
خَرَجَا: kharaja — to go out, leave (verb I, perf. 3md); 'the two of them went out'
بَابِ: bāb — gate, door (m., gen.; iḍāfa first term)
سِرِّ: sirr — secret (m., gen.; iḍāfa first term); 'the [secret] gate'
مُسَافِرَيْنِ: musāfir (dual) — musāfir, traveling (act. part. of III sāfara; m. dual acc., circumstantial)
أَيَّامًا: ayyām — yawm, day (m. pl. ayyām, acc., adverbial of time)
وَلَيَالِيَ: وَ + لَيَالِي — layālī, nights (f. pl. of layla, diptote; acc.)
وَسَطِ: wasaṭ — middle, midst (m., gen.; iḍāfa first term)
وَعَيْنِ: وَ + عَيْن — ʿayn, spring (f., gen.; iḍāfa first term)

وَصَعِدَ: وَ + صَعِدَ — ṣaʿida, to rise, ascend (verb I, perf. 3ms)
صَاعِدًا: ṣāʿid — rising, ascending (act. part. of ṣaʿida; m. acc., circumstantial)

قَاصِدٌ: qāṣid — heading for, making for (act. part. of qaṣada; m., nom.)

يَنْظُرَانِ: naẓara — to look (verb I, imperf. 3md indic.); 'the two of them looking'
ذَا: dhā — this/that; joined with مَا as 'what' (here written as two words)
يَكُونُ: kāna — to be, become (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms); 'it would be'
الْخَبَرُ: الـ + خَبَر — khabar, news, matter (m., nom.)
بِجِنِّيٍّ: بِـ + جِنِّيّ — jinniyy, a jinni, genie (m., gen. indef.); with wa-idhā, 'and lo, there was a jinni'
طَوِيلِ: ṭawīl — tall, long (adj., m., gen.; iḍāfa first term); 'tall of'
الْقَامَةِ: الـ + قَامَة — qāma, stature, figure (f., gen.)
عَرِيضِ: ʿarīḍ — broad, wide (adj., m., gen.; iḍāfa first term)
الْهَامَةِ: الـ + هَامَة — hāma, head, pate, skull (f., gen.)
وَاسِعِ: وَ + وَاسِع — wāsiʿ, wide, spacious (act. part. of wasiʿa; m., gen.; iḍāfa first term)
الصَّدْرِ: الـ + صَدْر — ṣadr, chest, breast (m., gen.)
فَطَلَعَ: فَـ + طَلَعَ — ṭalaʿa, to come up, emerge (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْبَرِّ: الـ + بَرّ — barr, dry land, shore (m., gen.)
وَأَتَى: وَ + أَتَى — atā, to come (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
هُمَا: humā — the two of them (pron., m. dual)
وَفَتَحَ: وَ + فَتَحَ — fataḥa, to open (verb I, perf. 3ms)
عُلْبَةً: ʿulba — small box, casket (f., acc. indef.)
فَتَحَهَا: فَتَحَ + ـهَا — fataḥa, to open (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs; 'he opened it'
فَخَرَجَتْ: فَـ + خَرَجَتْ — kharaja, to go/come out (verb I, perf. 3fs)
صَبِيَّةٌ: ṣabiyya — girl, young woman (f., nom. indef.)
بِقَامَةٍ: بِـ + قَامَةٍ — qāma, stature, figure (f., gen. indef.); 'with a figure'
هَيْفَاءَ: hayfāʾ — slender-waisted (color/quality adj., diptote, f.; gen.; edition already prints the hamza, kept precomposed)
بَهِيَّةٍ: bahiyya — radiant, lovely (adj., f., gen. indef.)
كَأَنَّهَا: كَأَنَّ + ـهَا — kaʾanna, as though (particle) + 3fs; 'as though she'
شَمْسٌ: shams — sun (f., nom. indef.; predicate of kaʾanna)
مُضِيئَةٌ: muḍīʾa — shining, luminous (act. part. of IV aḍāʾa; f., nom. indef.; edition already prints the hamza, kept precomposed)
وَأَحْسَنَ: وَ + أَحْسَنَ — aḥsana, to do well (verb IV, perf. 3ms); exclamatory, 'how well he put it'
الشَّاعِرُ: الـ + شَاعِر — shāʿir, poet (act. part. of shaʿara; m., nom.)
عَطِيَّةُ: ʿAṭiyya — a man's proper name (m., nom.)
اَشْرَقَتْ: ashraqat — to shine forth, rise radiantly (verb IV, perf. 3fs; verse, kept as printed)
فِيْ: fī — in (prep.; verse spelling with an extra yāʾ for the meter)
فَلَاحَ: فَـ + لَاحَ — lāḥa, to gleam, shine out (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
النَّهَارْ: الـ + نَهَار — nahār, day, daylight (m.; verse pausal form)
وَاَنَارَتْ: وَ + أَنَارَتْ — anāra, to light up, illuminate (verb IV, perf. 3fs)
الْاَشْجَارْ: الـ + أَشْجَار — shajar, tree (m. pl. ashjār; verse pausal form)
سَنَاهَا: سَنَا + ـهَا — sanā, radiance, brilliance (m.) + 3fs; 'her radiance'
الشُّمُوْسُ: الـ + شُمُوس — shams, sun (f. pl. shumūs; verse spelling with an extra wāw)
تُشْرِقُ: ashraqa — to shine, rise radiantly (verb IV, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with the non-human pl. shumūs)
تَتَجَلَّى: tajallā — to become manifest, reveal oneself (verb V, imperf. 3fs)
وَتَبْدُوْ: وَ + تَبْدُو — badā, to appear, show oneself (verb I, imperf. 3fs; verse spelling with an extra wāw)
تَخْجَلُ: khajila — to feel shame, blush (verb I, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with the non-human pl. aqmār); 'they are put to shame'
الْاَقْمَارْ: الـ + أَقْمَار — qamar, moon (m. pl. aqmār; verse pausal form)
تَسْجُدُ: sajada — to bow down, prostrate oneself (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
الْكَائِنَاتُ: الـ + كَائِنَات — kāʾin, existing thing, creature (act. part. of kāna; f. pl., nom.)
يَدَيْهَا: يَد (dual) + ـهَا — yad, hand (f. dual) + 3fs; 'her two hands'
حِينَ: ḥīna — when, at the time that (adv.)
تَبْدُو: badā — to appear, show oneself (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
وَتَهْتِكُ: وَ + تَهْتِكُ — hataka, to rend, tear away (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
الْاَسْتَارْ: الـ + أَسْتَار — sitr, veil, curtain (m. pl. astār; verse pausal form)
وَاِذَا: وَ + إِذَا — idhā, when, whenever (particle; verse spelling)
اَوْمَضَتْ: awmaḍat — to flash, gleam (verb IV, perf. 3fs)
بُرُوقُ: بَرْق (pl.) — barq, lightning-flash (m. pl. burūq, nom.; iḍāfa first term)
حِمَاهَا: حِمَى + ـهَا — ḥimā, protected precinct, sanctuary (m.) + 3fs; 'her sanctuary' (see note)
اَهْطَلَتْ: ahṭalat — to pour down, rain heavily (verb IV, perf. 3fs)
بِالْمَدَامِعِ: بِـ + الـ + مَدَامِع — madmaʿ, tear (m. pl. madāmiʿ, gen.); 'as tears'
الْاَمْطَارْ: الـ + أَمْطَار — maṭar, rain (m. pl. amṭār; verse pausal form)
إِلَيْهَا: إِلَى + ـهَا — ilā, to, toward (prep.) + 3fs; 'at her'
سِتَّ: sitt — mistress, lady (contracted colloquial form of sayyida; f., acc., vocative; iḍāfa first term)
الْحَرَائِرِ: الـ + حَرَائِر — ḥarāʾir, free/noble women (f. pl. of ḥurra; gen.; edition already prints the hamza, kept precomposed)
قَدِ: qad — indeed, already (particle before the perfect; -i before the following hamzat al-waṣl)
اخْتَطَفَتْكِ: ikhtaṭafat — to snatch away, abduct (verb VIII, perf. 3fs) + 2fs object suffix; 'it snatched you away' (see note — the grammatical subject is 'your wedding-night')
لَيْلَةَ: layla — night (f., acc., adverbial; iḍāfa first term)
عُرْسِكِ: عُرْس + ـكِ — ʿurs, wedding (m., gen.) + 2fs; 'your wedding'
أَنَامُ: nāma — to sleep (verb I hollow, imperf. 1s); 'I sleep' (see note on the dropped أَنْ)
قَلِيلًا: qalīl — little, a little while (adj. used adverbially; m., acc. indef.)
الْجِنِّيَّ: الـ + جِنِّيّ — jinniyy, jinni (m., acc.; subject of inna)
رَأْسَهُ: رَأْس + ـهُ — raʾs, head (m., acc.) + 3ms; 'his head'
رُكْبَةِ: rukba — knee (f., gen.; iḍāfa first term)
وَنَامَ: وَ + نَامَ — nāma, to sleep (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
فَرَفَعَتِ: فَ + رَفَعَتِ — rafaʿa, to raise, lift (verb I, perf. 3fs; kasra before the following hamzat waṣl); 'and she raised'
الصَّبِيَّةُ: الـ + صَبِيَّة — ṣabiyya, girl, young woman (f., nom.); 'the girl' (subject)
رَأْسَهَا: رَأْس + ـهَا — raʾs, head (m., acc.) + 3fs poss.; 'her head'
فَرَأَتِ: فَ + رَأَتِ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3fs; kasra before the following hamzat waṣl); 'and she saw'
الْمَلِكَيْنِ: الـ + مَلِكَيْن — malik, king (m. dual acc.); 'the two kings'
وَهُمَا: وَ + هُمَا — wa, and (here circumstantial, 'while') + humā, they two (3rd dual pron.); 'they [being]'
فَشَالَتْ: فَ + شَالَتْ — shāla, to lift, hoist, carry off (verb I hollow, colloquial; perf. 3fs); 'then she lifted'
رَأْسَ: raʾs — head (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْجِنِّيِّ: الـ + جِنِّيّ — jinniyy, jinni, genie (m., gen.; nisba-adjective of jinn used as a noun)
رُكْبَتِهَا: رُكْبَة + ـهَا — rukba, knee, lap (f., gen.) + 3fs poss.; 'her knee'
وَوَضَعَتْهَا: وَ + وَضَعَتْ + ـهَا — waḍaʿa, to put, place (verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3fs obj. (referring loosely to the masc. رَأْس, 'head' — see note); 'and she put it'
الْأَرْضِ: الـ + أَرْض — arḍ, ground, earth (f., gen.)
وَوَقَفَتْ: وَ + وَقَفَتْ — waqafa, to stand, stop (verb I, perf. 3fs)
وَقَالَتْ: وَ + قَالَتْ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs)
لَهُمَا: لِـ + ـهُمَا — li-, to, for (prep.) + 3rd dual suffix; 'to them two'
بِالْإِشَارَةِ: بِـ + الـ + إِشَارَة — ishāra, sign, gesture (f., gen.; verbal noun of IV ashāra); 'by gesture'
اِنْزِلَا: nazala — to go down, descend (verb I, imper. 2m dual; hamzat waṣl); 'come down, you two!'
تَخَافَا: khāfa — to fear (verb I hollow, jussive 2m dual after lā); 'do not fear'
الْعِفْرِيتِ: الـ + عِفْرِيت — ʿifrīt, ifrit, demon (m., gen.)
فَقَالَا: فَ + قَالَا — qāla (verb I hollow, perf. 3m dual); 'then the two said'
بِاللَّهِ: بِـ + اللَّه — Allāh, God (gen., in an oath formula); 'by God'
عَلَيْكِ: عَلَى + ـكِ — ʿalā, upon (prep.) + 2fs suffix; 'upon you' (oath formula, addressed to her)

عَنَّا: عَنْ + ـنَا — ʿan, from, about (prep.) + 1pl suffix; 'from us'
إِنْ: in — if (conditional particle, governs the jussive)
لَمْ: lam — not (neg. particle governing the jussive; negates the past or, colloquially, an immediate refusal)
تَنْزِلَا: nazala — to descend (jussive 2m dual after lam); 'you two do not come down'
نَبَّهْتُ: nabbaha — to rouse, alert, wake (verb II, perf. 1cs); 'I will rouse' (perfect used with threatening future force)
عَلَيْكُمَا: عَلَى + ـكُمَا — ʿalā + 2m dual suffix; 'against you two, upon you two'
يَقْتُلُكُمَا: قَتَلَ + ـكُمَا — qatala, to kill (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.) + 2m dual obj.; 'he will kill you two'
شَرَّ: sharr — evil, worst (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the worst of'
قَتْلَةٍ: qatla — a killing, a death (f. noun of single instance, gen. indef.)
فَخَافَا: فَ + خَافَا — khāfa, to fear (perf. 3m dual); 'so the two feared'
وَنَزَلَا: وَ + نَزَلَا — nazala (perf. 3m dual); 'and the two came down'
فَقَامَتْ: فَ + قَامَتْ — qāma, to rise, stand up (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs)
وَقَالَتِ: وَ + قَالَتِ — qāla (perf. 3fs; kasra before the following hamzat waṣl)
اِرْصَعَا: irṣaʿā — obscure verb (imper. 2m dual); no dictionary attests the root ر-ص-ع in a sexual sense, but context leaves the general force in no doubt — see the note on this unit
عَنِيفًا: ʿanīf — violent, rough, forceful (adj. used adverbially, acc. indef.); 'forcefully'
أُنَبِّهُ: nabbaha — to rouse, alert (verb II, imperf. 1cs indic.); 'I will rouse'
لَكُمَا: لِـ + ـكُمَا — li- + 2m dual suffix; 'against you two'
خَوْفِهِ: خَوْف + ـهِ — khawf, fear (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'his fear'
افْعَلْ: faʿala — to do (verb I, imper. 2ms; hamzat waṣl); 'do!'
أَمَرْتُكَ: أَمَرَ + ـتُ + ـكَ — amara, to command (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 2ms obj.; 'I commanded you'
أَفْعَلْ: faʿala — to do (jussive 1cs after lam); 'I will [not] do'
قَبْلِي: قَبْلَ + ـِي — qabla, before (adv.) + 1cs suffix; 'before me'
وَأَخَذَا: وَ + أَخَذَا — akhadha, to take; [+ imperf.] to begin to (verb I, perf. 3m dual); 'and the two began'
يَتَغَامَزَانِ: taghāmaza — to wink at one another (verb VI, imperf. 3m dual); 'winking at each other'
نَيْكِهَا: نَيْك + ـهَا — nayk, the plain obscene word for sexual intercourse, the exact force of English 'fuck' (verbal noun, m., gen.) + 3fs poss.; 'having sex with her'
أَرَاكُمَا: رَأَى + ـكُمَا — raʾā, to see (verb I, imperf. 1cs) + 2m dual obj.; 'I see you two'
تَتَغَامَزَانِ: taghāmaza — to wink at one another (imperf. 2m dual indic.); 'you two are winking at each other'
تَتَقَدَّمَا: taqaddama — to come forward, advance (verb V, jussive 2m dual after lam); 'you two come forward'

اسْتَقْفَاهَا: اِسْتَقْفَى + ـهَا — istaqfā, to follow after, take one's turn with (verb X of qafā, perf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl) + 3fs obj.; 'he took his turn with her'
الِاثْنَانِ: اِثْنَانِ — ithnān, two, the two [of them] (m. dual nom.; hamzat waṣl)
فَرَغَا: faragha — to finish, be done (verb I, perf. 3m dual); 'the two had finished'
أَفِيقَا: أَفَاقَ — afāqa, to recover, come to oneself (verb IV, imper. 2m dual); 'recover! come to yourselves!'
وَأَخْرَجَتْ: وَ + أَخْرَجَتْ — akhraja, to bring out, take out (verb IV, perf. 3fs)
جَيْبِهَا: جَيْب + ـهَا — jayb, bosom, the breast-fold of a garment used as a pocket (m., gen.) + 3fs poss.; 'her bosom'
عِقْدًا: ʿiqd — string (of beads or rings), necklace (m., acc. indef.)

الْخَوَاتِمِ: الـ + خَوَاتِم — khātam, ring (m. pl. khawātim, gen.)
كُلُّهُمْ: كُلّ + ـهُمْ — kull, each, all (m., nom.) + 3mp poss.; 'all of them, every one of them'
نَاكُونِي: نَاكَ + ـونِي — nāka, to have sex with (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp; the plain obscene verb) + 1cs obj.; 'they had sex with me'
قَرْنِ: qarn — horn (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
فَأَعْطِيَانِي: فَ + أَعْطِيَا + ـنِي — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, imper. 2m dual) + 1cs obj.; 'so give me!'
خَاتَمَيْكُمَا: خَاتَمَيْ + ـكُمَا — khātam, ring (m. dual acc.) + 2m dual poss.; 'your two rings'
الْأَخَوَيْنِ: الـ + أَخَوَيْن — akh, brother (m. dual akhawayn, acc./gen.); 'the two brothers'
فَأَعْطَاهَا: فَ + أَعْطَى + ـهَا — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 3ms — spelled singular though both brothers are meant, see note) + 3fs obj.; 'so he/they gave her'
أَيْدِيهِمَا: أَيْدِي + ـهِمَا — yad, hand (f., broken pl. aydin/aydī, gen.) + 3rd dual poss.; 'their two hands'
اخْتَطَفَنِي: اِخْتَطَفَ + ـنِي — ikhtaṭafa, to snatch away, abduct (verb VIII of khaṭafa, perf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl) + 1cs obj.; 'he snatched me away'
عُرْسِي: عُرْس + ـِي — ʿurs, wedding (m., gen.) + 1cs poss.; 'my wedding'
وَضَعَنِي: وَضَعَ + ـنِي — waḍaʿa, to put, place (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'he put me'
وَجَعَلَ: وَ + جَعَلَ — jaʿala, to put, make, place (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْعُلْبَةَ: الـ + عُلْبَة — ʿulba, box, casket (f., acc.)
الصُّنْدُوقِ: الـ + صُنْدُوق — ṣundūq, chest, box (m., gen.)
وَرَمَى: وَ + رَمَى — ramā, to throw, cast (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
سَبْعَةَ: sabʿa — seven (numeral, f. form, acc., governing a gen. pl.)

يَرْجِعُونَ: yarjiʿūna — rajaʿa, to return, bring back (verb I, imperf. 3mp)

تَأْكُلْهُ: taʾkul + -hu — akala, to eat (verb I, jussive 2ms after lā) + 3ms object; 'do not eat it'

ضَعِيفٌ: ḍaʿīf — weak, feeble (adj., m., nom. indef.)

فَتَسْتَرِيحُ: فَـ + تَسْتَرِيحُ — istarāḥa, to rest (verb X, imperf. 2ms)
التَّعَبِ: الـ + تَعَب — taʿab, fatigue, weariness (m., gen.)
وَالْجَهْدِ: وَ + الـ + جَهْد — jahd, toil, exertion (m., gen.)
يَسْمَعُ: yasmaʿu — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
كَلَامَهُمَا: kalām + -humā — kalām, speech, talk (m., acc.) + 3md suffix; 'their (two) talk'
السَّوَّاقُ: الـ + سَوَّاق — sawwāq, drover, driver (intensive noun of agent, m., nom.)

وَأَصْبَحَ: وَ + أَصْبَحَ — aṣbaḥa, to come to be, to do in the morning (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
يَأْخُذُ: yaʾkhudhu — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
فَوَجَادَهُ: فَـ + وَجَدَ + ـهُ — wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; prints with an extra plene alif (فوجاده) not seen in the identical phrase earlier, but read the same way
فَحَزِنَ: فَـ + حَزِنَ — ḥazina, to grieve (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَقَٰلَ: وَ + قَالَ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); printed defectively قل
قَدَرَ: qadara — to be able (verb I, perf. 3ms)
يَشْغُلُ: yashghulu — shaghala, to work, be occupied (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
الْحَرْثِ: الـ + حَرْث — ḥarth, ploughing, tillage (m., gen.)
مُتَقَصِّرٌ: mutaqaṣṣir — falling short, remiss, off his feed (act. part. of V taqaṣṣara; m., nom. indef.)
يَأْكُلْ: yaʾkul — akala, to eat (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam)
اللَّيْلَةَ: الـ + لَيْلَة — layla, night (f., acc. as adv.); 'this night'
ذَاقَ: dhāqa — to taste (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)

اِمْضِ: imḍi — maḍā, to go, proceed (verb I, imper. 2ms); 'go!'

الزَّرَّاعُ: الـ + زَرَّاع — zarrāʿ, sower, ploughman, farmer (intensive noun of profession; m., nom.)
وَأَخَذَ: وَ + أَخَذَ — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3ms)

فَمَا: فَـ + مَا — fa-, so/and + mā, not (neg. particle)

مَيِّتًا: mayyit — dead (act. part. of māta; m. acc. indef., ḥāl)

فَشَكَرَهُ: فَـ + شَكَرَ + ـهُ — shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms suffix
وَمَدَحَهُ: وَ + مَدَحَ + ـهُ — madaḥa, to praise (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms suffix
قَاعِدًا: qāʿid — sitting, seated (act. part. of qaʿada; m. acc. indef., khabar kāna)

يَقُمِ: yaqum — he rises, gets up (qāma, imperf. 3ms jussive after lam; -i- helping vowel before the following al-)

عَلَفَهُ: عَلَف + ـهُ — ʿalaf, fodder (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his fodder'

طَلَعَ: ṭalaʿa — to go up, climb, ascend, rise (verb I, perf. 3ms) — of a person climbing, or of the day breaking; with ilā + a person, idiomatically 'to go in to, be brought before'

دَارِ: dār — house, dwelling (f., gen. as first term of idāfa)
الْبَقَرِ: الـ + بَقَر — baqar, cattle, oxen (coll., m., gen.); دَارِ الْبَقَرِ, 'the cattle-house, byre'
فَجَاءَ: فَـ + جَاءَ — fa-, then + jāʾa, to come (perf. 3ms)
أُسْتَاذَهُ: أُسْتَاذ + ـهُ — ustādh, master (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his master'
طَرْطَرَ: ṭarṭara — to flick, whisk (about) (quadriliteral verb I, perf. 3ms; of a tail)
ذَيْلَهُ: ذَيْل + ـهُ — dhayl, tail (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix
وَضَرَطَ: وَ + ضَرَطَ — wa-, and + ḍaraṭa, to fart (verb I, perf. 3ms)

فَضَحِكَ: فَـ + ضَحِكَ — fa-, so + ḍaḥika, to laugh (verb I, perf. 3ms)
اسْتَلْقَى: istalqā — to lie back, fall backward (verb X, perf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl, initial alif unmarked)
قَفَاهُ: قَفَا + ـهُ — qafā, nape, back of the neck (m., defective noun) + 3ms suffix
زَوْجَتُهُ: زَوْجَة + ـهُ — zawja, wife (f., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his wife'
أَيِّ: ayy — which (interrog./indef. noun, gen. as first term of idāfa with shayʾ)
رَأَيْتُهُ: raʾaytu — I saw (raʾā, perf. 1cs; the edition already prints the hamza here, kept precomposed) + 3ms object suffix
وَسَمِعْتُهُ: وَ + سَمِعْتُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + samiʿtu, I heard (perf. 1cs) + 3ms object suffix
أَبُوحُ: abūḥu — I disclose, reveal (bāḥa, imperf. 1cs, measure I)
فَأَمُوتَ: فَـ + أَمُوتَ — fa-, so/or else + amūta, I die (māta, imperf. 1cs subjunctive after fa- of result)

وَبِسَبَبِ: وَ + بِـ + سَبَب — wa-, and + bi-, by reason of + sabab, cause, reason (m., gen.)

خَوْفًا: khawf — fear (m., acc. indef., object for the sake of which); 'for fear'

تَزَلْ: tazal — she ceases (zāla, imperf. 3fs jussive after lam; lam tazal, 'she did not cease')
تُلِحُّ: tuliḥḥu — she presses, insists (alaḥḥa, imperf. 3fs, measure IV of laḥḥa)

غُلِبَ: ghuliba — he was overcome, overpowered (ghalaba, perf. 3ms pass.)
وَضَجِرَ: وَ + ضَجِرَ — wa-, and + ḍajira, to grow weary, exasperated (verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَأَحْضَرَ: فَـ + أَحْضَرَ — fa-, so + aḥḍara, to summon, bring (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
أَوْلَادَهُ: أَوْلَاد + ـهُ — awlād, children, sons (m. pl.; acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his children'

يُوصِيَ: yūṣiya — he make his testament, bequeath (awṣā, imperf. 3ms subjunctive, measure IV)

بِالسِّرِّ: بِـ + الـ + سِرّ — bi-, with + sirr, secret (m., gen.)
وَيَمُوتَ: وَ + يَمُوتَ — wa-, and + yamūta, he die (māta, imperf. 3ms subjunctive)
لِأَنَّهُ: لِـ + أَنَّ + ـهُ — li-, because + anna, that (particle) + 3ms suffix as its subject; 'because he'
يُحِبُّهَا: yuḥibbu — he loves (aḥabba, imperf. 3ms, measure IV) + 3fs object suffix

عَظِيمَةً: ʿaẓīma — great, mighty (adj., f. sg. acc. agreeing with maḥabba)
بِنْتُ: bint — daughter (f., nom., first term of idāfa)
عَمِّهِ: عَمّ + ـهِ — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his paternal uncle'

أَوْلَادِهِ: أَوْلَاد + ـهِ — awlād, children (m. pl., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his children'

وَعِشْرِينَ: وَ + عِشْرِينَ — wa-, and + ʿishrīn, twenty (numeral, acc./gen. form)
أَبُو: abū — father of (m., nom. of the 'five nouns', first term of an iḍāfa, in apposition to zawjuki)
أَبِيهَا: أَب + ـهَا — ab, father (m.; one of the 'five nouns', oblique form abī) + 3fs poss.; 'her father'
أَحْضَرَ: aḥḍara — to have brought, cause to be present (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
أَرْجِعُ: arjiʿu — rajaʿa, to turn back, return (verb I, imperf. 1s)
أَسَرِّ: asarr — happiest, most delightful (elative of sārr; m., gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa); fī asarri l-aḥwāl = 'in the happiest of conditions', a fixed idiom
أَفْعَلُ: afʿalu — faʿala, to do (verb I, imperf. 1s); 'I will do' — not the imperative
أَقُولَ: aqūla — qāla, to say, tell (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 1s after ḥattā)
أَمْرَهُ: أَمْر + ـهُ — amr, affair, matter (m., acc. as object) + 3ms poss.; 'his affair'
أَهْلِهَا: أَهْل + ـهَا — ahl, people, family (m., gen. as second term of jamīʿ's iḍāfa) + 3fs poss.; 'her people'
أَوْلَادِكِ: أَوْلَاد + ـكِ — walad, child, son (m. pl. awlād; gen.) + 2fs poss.; 'your children'
أُرَاضِي: urāḍī — rāḍā, to please, keep content (verb III, imperf. 1s)
أُغْمِيَ: ughmiya — aghmā ʿalā, to overcome, cause to faint (verb IV, passive perf. 3ms); ughmiya ʿalayhā = 'she fainted'
ابْنَةُ: ibna — daughter (f., nom., hamzat waṣl, first term of an iḍāfa)
اتْرُكِي: تَرَكَ — taraka, to leave, abandon (verb I, imper. 2fs, hamzat waṣl); 'leave (it)!'
التَّاجِرَ: الـ + تَاجِر — tājir, merchant (m., acc. as subject of inna)
التُّوتِ: الـ + تُوت — tūt, mulberry (m., gen.); ʿīdān al-tūt = mulberry rods, switches for beating
الدَّوَابِّ: الـ + دَوَابّ — dābba, beast, animal (f. broken pl. dawābb; gen.); dār al-dawābb = the stable
الدِّيكَ: الـ + دِيك — dīk, rooster (m., acc. as object)
الدِّيكُ: الـ + دِيك — dīk, rooster (m., nom. as subject)
الدِّيكِ: الـ + دِيك — dīk, rooster (m., gen. after ʿalā)
الْأَحْوَالِ: الـ + أَحْوَال — ḥāl, state, condition (m./f. pl. aḥwāl; gen.)
الْجَمَاعَةُ: الـ + جَمَاعَة — jamāʿa, company, group, party (f., nom. as subject)
الْخِزَانَةَ: الـ + خِزَانَة — khizāna, closet, storeroom (f., acc. as object)
الْخِزَانَةِ: الـ + خِزَانَة — khizāna, closet, storeroom (f., gen.)
الْعَقْلِ: الـ + عَقْل — ʿaql, mind, reason, wit (m., gen.)
الْقِصَّةَ: الـ + قِصَّة — qiṣṣa, story, tale (f., acc. as object)
الْكَلْبَ: الـ + كَلْب — kalb, dog (m., acc. as object)
الْكَلْبُ: الـ + كَلْب — kalb, dog (m., nom. as subject)
الْمَمَاتِ: الـ + مَمَات — mamāt, death (m., gen. after ilā)
بَابَ: bāb — door, gate (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
بَاسَتْ: bāsat — bāsa, to kiss (verb I, perf. 3fs)
بِالضَّرْبِ: بِـ + الـ + ضَرْب — ḍarb, beating, striking (m., gen. after bi-)
بِزَوْجَتِهِ: بِـ + زَوْجَة + ـهِ — zawja, wife (f., gen. after bi-) + 3ms poss.; 'with his wife'
بِهَا: بِـ + ـهَا — bi-, with (prep.) + 3fs suffix; 'with her'
تَتُوبَ: tatūba — tāba, to repent, turn back (verb I, imperf. subjunctive 3fs)
تَسْأَلُهُ: تَسْأَلُ + ـهُ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, imperf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.; the edition already prints the hamza seat here
تَعُودَ: taʿūda — ʿāda, to return, go back (to doing something) (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 3fs)
تَمُوتَ: tamūta — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 3fs after ḥattā)
تُبْتُ: tubtu — tāba, to repent, turn back (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I repent'
جَارَتِهِ: جَارَة + ـهِ — jāra, female neighbor (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'his (female) neighbor'
جَمِيعُ: jamīʿ — all, the whole of (m., nom. as subject, first term of an iḍāfa)
حَضَرَهَا: حَضَرَ + ـهَا — ḥaḍara, to be present, attend (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'was present with her'
حِكَايَةٌ: ḥikāya — tale, story (f., nom. indef., delayed subject of the nominal sentence)
خِزَانَةٍ: khizāna — closet, storeroom, cabinet (f., gen. indef. after ilā)
دَجَاجَةً: dajāja — hen (f., acc. sg. as the counted noun after khamsūna)
دَخَلَ: dakhala — to enter, go in (verb I, perf. 3ms)
دِيكٌ: dīk — rooster, cock (m., nom. indef., subject of kāna)
رَائِحٌ: rāʾiḥ — going, departing (act. part. I of rāḥa; m. nom.); with a following imperfect, 'going to, about to'
زَوْجَةً: zawja — wife (f., acc. sg. as the counted noun after khamsīna)
زَوْجَةٍ: zawja — wife (f., gen. indef., second term of the iḍāfa with fardu)
زَوْجُكِ: زَوْج + ـكِ — zawj, husband (m., nom. as subject) + 2fs poss.; 'your husband'
سَمِعَتِ: samiʿati — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, perf. 3fs; final vowel -i as liaison before the following hamzat waṣl)
سِرِّهِ: سِرّ + ـهِ — sirr, secret (m., gen. after ʿalā) + 3ms poss.; 'his secret'
شَهْرَزَادَ: Shahrazād — the vizier's daughter's name (proper name, diptote, gen. in apposition to ibnatihi)
شَيْ: shayʾ — thing, anything; the edition's colloquial spelling drops the word's final hamza entirely, shay for shayʾ
عَلَيْهَا: عَلَى + ـهَا — ʿalā, upon, against (prep.) + 3fs suffix; here 'for use against her'
عَنْهُ: عَنْ + ـهُ — ʿan, from, away from (prep.) + 3ms suffix; 'from it'
عِنْدِهِمْ: عِنْدَ + ـهِمْ — ʿinda, at, with, among (prep.) + 3mp suffix; 'from among them'
عِيدَانِ: عِيدَان — ʿūd, stick, rod (m. pl. ʿīdān; gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
فَأَعَادَ: فَـ + أَعَادَ — aʿāda, to repeat, do again (verb IV, perf. 3ms); with ʿalā, 'to recount to'
فَدَخَلَتْ: فَـ + دَخَلَتْ — dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'so she entered'
فَرْحَانُ: farḥān — joyful, glad (adj. of the faʿlān pattern, m. nom., predicate of anta)
فَرْدُ: fard — single, sole (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
فَسَكَتُوا: فَـ + سَكَتُوا — sakata, to fall silent (verb I, perf. 3mp)
فَسَمِعَ: فَـ + سَمِعَ — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَامَ: qāma — to rise, get up (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
قَفَلَ: qafala — to lock, bolt (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَلِيلُ: qalīl — little, scant (adj., m. nom., first term of an iḍāfa, predicate of inna); qalīl al-ʿaql = 'scant of wit, foolish'
لِئَلَّا: لِـ + أَلَّا — li- + allā (an + lā), so that not; 'lest'
لِابْنَتِهِ: لِـ + ابْنَة + ـهِ — ibna, daughter (f., gen. after li-, hamzat waṣl) + 3ms poss.; 'to his daughter'
لِلْكَلْبِ: لِـ + الـ + كَلْب — kalb, dog (m., gen. after li-)
مَاتَ: māta — to die (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
مَعَكِ: مَعَ + ـكِ — maʿa, with (prep.) + 2fs suffix; 'with you'
مَقَالَةَ: maqāla — saying, speech, utterance (f., acc. as object, first term of an iḍāfa)
مِثْلَ: mithla — like, the equal of (adv. acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
وَأَدَعَهُ: وَ + أَدَعَ + ـهُ — wadaʿa/yadaʿu, to leave, let be (verb I, defective in the perfect, imperf. subjunctive 1s) + 3ms obj.; 'and I leave him'
وَأَمُوتَ: وَ + أَمُوتَ — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 1s)
وَأَهْلَ: وَ + أَهْل — ahl, people, family (m., acc., coordinate object of aḥḍara, first term of its own iḍāfa)
وَأَهْلُهَا: وَ + أَهْل + ـهَا — ahl, people, family (m., nom.) + 3fs poss.; 'and her people'
وَأُسْتَاذُنَا: وَ + أُسْتَاذ + ـنَا — ustādh, master (m., nom. as topic) + 1pl poss.; 'and our master'
وَأُصَالِحُ: وَ + أُصَالِحُ — ṣālaḥa, to make peace with, reconcile with (verb III, imperf. 1s)
وَإِنَّهُ: وَ + إِنَّ + ـهُ — inna, indeed (particle) + 3ms subject; 'and indeed he/it'
وَإِيَّاهُ: وَ + إِيَّا + ـهُ — iyyā-, the independent object-pronoun base + 3ms suffix; 'and him'
وَتَابَتْ: وَ + تَابَتْ — tāba, to repent, turn back (verb I, perf. 3fs)
وَتَحْتَهُ: وَ + تَحْتَ + ـهُ — taḥta, under, beneath (prep.) + 3ms suffix; 'and under him'
وَتَوَجَّهَ: وَ + تَوَجَّهَ — tawajjaha, to make one's way, set out (verb V, perf. 3ms)
وَخَبَأَهُمْ: وَ + خَبَأَ + ـهُمْ — khabaʾa, to hide, conceal (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3mp obj.; the edition already prints this hamza; 'and hid them'
وَخَرَجَتْ: وَ + خَرَجَتْ — kharaja, to go out, leave (verb I, perf. 3fs)
وَرِجْلَيْهِ: وَ + رِجْل (dual) + ـهِ — rijl, foot (f. dual acc. rijlayn) + 3ms poss.; 'and his two feet'
وَفَرِحُوا: وَ + فَرِحُوا — fariḥa, to rejoice, be glad (verb I, perf. 3mp)
وَقَعَدُوا: وَ + قَعَدُوا — qaʿada, to sit, settle, remain (verb I, perf. 3mp)
وَنَزَلَ: وَ + نَزَلَ — nazala, to come down, descend (verb I, perf. 3ms); with ʿalā bi-, 'to set upon with'
وَيَدْخُلْ: وَ + يَدْخُلْ — dakhala, to enter, go in (verb I, imperf. jussive 3ms, coordinate with yaʾkhudh under lam)
وَيَسُبُّ: وَ + يَسُبُّ — sabba, to curse, revile (verb I doubled, imperf. 3ms)
وَيَضْرِبْهَا: وَ + يَضْرِبْ + ـهَا — ḍaraba, to strike, beat (verb I, imperf. jussive 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'and beat her'
وَيَقُولُ: وَ + يَقُولُ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms)
وَيَمُوتُ: وَ + يَمُوتُ — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. indic. 3ms)
يَأْخُذْ: yaʾkhudh — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. jussive 3ms after lam); the edition prints يأخذ with its hamza seat already in place
يَتَوَضَّى: tawaḍḍā — to perform ablution, wash (verb V, imperf. 3ms); the edition drops the verb's usual final hamza (Classical tawaḍḍaʾa), spelling it as a final-weak verb
يَسُوسُ: yasūsu — sāsa, to manage, govern, administer (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms); here as a bare complement verb after yaʿrifu, 'know how to manage'
يَعْرِفُ: yaʿrifu — ʿarafa, to know (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
يَقُولَ: yaqūla — qāla, to say, tell (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 3ms after ḥattā)
يَمُوتَ: yamūta — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 3ms after li-allā)
يَمُوتُ: yamūtu — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. indic. 3ms); 'he dies'
يَنْظُرَنِي: yanẓuranī — naẓara, to look, see (verb I, imperf. subjunctive 3ms) + 1s obj.; 'see me'
يُخَاطِبُ: yukhāṭibu — khāṭaba, to address, speak to (verb III, imperf. 3ms)
يُنَادِي: yunādī — nādā, to call out, cry aloud (verb III, imperf. 3ms)
فَجَهَّزَهَا: فَ + جَهَّزَ + هَا — jahhaza, to make ready, equip, prepare (a bride) (v. II, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'so he made her ready'
وَطَلَعَ: وَ + طَلَعَ — ṭalaʿa, to go up, ascend; here loosely 'go in to' (v. I, perf. 3ms)
أَوْصَتْ: awṣat — awṣā, to charge, instruct, enjoin (v. IV, perf. 3fs); 'she had instructed'
أُخْتَهَا: أُخْت + هَا — ukht, sister (f., acc.) + 3fs poss.; 'her sister'
الصَّغِيرَةَ: الـ + صَغِيرَة — ṣaghīr, young, little (adj., f. sg., acc.)
تَوَجَّهْتُ: tawajjahtu — tawajjaha, to set out, head toward, proceed (v. V, perf. 1cs); 'I have gone, I proceed'
أُرْسِلُ: ursilu — arsala, to send (v. IV, imperf. 1cs); 'I send, I will send'
أَطْلُبُكِ: أَطْلُبُ + كِ — ṭalaba, to seek, ask for, send for (v. I, imperf. 1cs) + 2fs obj.; 'I summon you'
فَإِذَا: فَ + إِذَا — fa-, so, then + idhā, when; 'then when'
جِئْتِ: jiʾti — jāʾa, to come (v. I, perf. 2fs); 'you have come'
وَرَأَيْتِ: وَ + رَأَيْتِ — raʾā, to see (v. I, perf. 2fs); 'and you have seen'
قَضَى: qaḍā — to accomplish, fulfill, finish (v. I, perf. 3ms)
حَاجَتَهُ: حَاجَة + هُ — ḥāja, need, want (f., acc.) + 3ms poss.; 'his need'
تَقُولِي: taqūlī — qāla, to say (v. I, imperf./juss. 2fs, without the final nūn); 'you shall say'
أُخْتِي: أُخْت + ي — ukht, sister (f.) + 1cs poss.; 'my sister'
حَدِّثِينِي: حَدِّثِي + نِي — ḥaddatha, to tell, narrate, relate (v. II, imper. 2fs) + 1cs obj.; 'tell me'
حَدِيثًا: ḥadīthan — ḥadīth, an account, a tale, a discourse (m., indef. acc.)
وَكَلَامًا: وَ + كَلَامًا — kalām, speech, talk, conversation (m., indef. acc.)
نَقْطَعُ: naqṭaʿu — qaṭaʿa, to cut (v. I, imperf. 1pl); with bi-, 'we while away, pass (the time)'
وَالسَّهَرَ: وَ + الـ + سَهَر — sahar, wakefulness, sleeplessness (m., acc.)
أُحَدِّثُكِ: أُحَدِّثُ + كِ — ḥaddatha, to tell, relate (v. II, imperf. 1cs) + 2fs obj.; 'I shall tell you'
شَاءَ: shāʾa — to will, wish (v. I, perf. 3ms)
الْخَلَاصُ: الـ + خَلَاص — khalāṣ, deliverance, escape, release (m., nom.)
أَبَاهَا: أَب + هَا — ab, father (m., irregular noun, acc. as ism of inna) + 3fs poss.; 'her father'
رَآهُ: رَأَى + هُ — raʾā, to see (v. I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'he saw him'
فَرِحَ: fariḥa — to rejoice, be glad (v. I, perf. 3ms)
أَتَيْتَ: atayta — atā, to come, bring (v. I, perf. 2ms); 'you have brought'
بِحَاجَتِي: بِـ + حَاجَة + ي — ḥāja, need (f., gen. after bi-) + 1cs poss.; 'with my need'
يَدْخُلَ: yadkhula — dakhala, to enter, go in (v. I, imperf. subj. 3ms)
فَبَكَتْ: فَ + بَكَتْ — bakā, to weep (v. I, perf. 3fs)
مَالَكِ: مَا + لَـ + كِ — mā, what (interrog.) + li- + 2fs; 'what is with you, what ails you' (printed by the edition as one word)
أَيُّهَا: ayyuhā — O (vocative particle used before a following definite noun)
صَغِيرَةً: ṣaghīratan — ṣaghīr, young, little (adj., f. sg., indef. acc.)
وَأُرِيدُ: وَ + أُرِيدُ — arāda, to want, wish (v. IV, imperf. 1cs)
أُوَدِّعَهَا: وَدَّعَ + هَا — waddaʿa, to bid farewell to, take leave of (v. II, subj. 1cs after an) + 3fs obj.; 'that I bid her farewell'
فَأَرْسَلَ: فَ + أَرْسَلَ — arsala, to send (v. IV, perf. 3ms)
فَجَاءَتْ: فَ + جَاءَتْ — jāʾa, to come (v. I, perf. 3fs)
أُخْتِهَا: أُخْت + هَا — ukht, sister (f., gen.) + 3fs poss.
وَعَانَقَتْهَا: وَ + عَانَقَتْ + هَا — ʿānaqa, to embrace (v. III, perf. 3fs) + 3fs obj.
وَجَلَسَتْ: وَ + جَلَسَتْ — jalasa, to sit (v. I, perf. 3fs)
السَّرِيرِ: الـ + سَرِير — sarīr, bed, couch (m., gen.)
فَقَامَ: فَ + قَامَ — qāma, to rise, stand up (v. I, perf. 3ms)
بَكَارَتَهَا: بَكَارَة + هَا — bakāra, virginity, maidenhead (f., acc.) + 3fs poss.
يَتَحَدَّثُونَ: yataḥaddathūna — taḥaddatha, to converse, talk together (v. V, imperf. 3mp)
أُخْتُهَا: أُخْت + هَا — ukht, sister (f., nom.) + 3fs poss.
الصَّغِيرَةُ: الـ + صَغِيرَة — ṣaghīr, young, little (adj., f. sg., nom.)
حَدِّثِينَا: حَدِّثِي + نَا — ḥaddatha, to tell (v. II, imper. 2fs) + 1pl obj.; 'tell us'
سَهَرَ: sahara — sahar, wakefulness, sleeplessness (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
لَيْلَتِنَا: لَيْلَة + نَا — layla, night (f., gen.) + 1pl poss.; 'our night'
حُبًّا: ḥubban — ḥubb, love, fondness (m., indef. acc. of manner); with wa-karāmatan, the fixed idiom 'gladly'
أَذِنَ: adhina — to give leave, permit (v. I, perf. 3ms)
الْمُهَذَّبُ: الـ + مُهَذَّب — muhadhdhab, refined, courteous, well-bred (pass. part. of II hadhdhaba; m., nom.)
مِنْهُمَا: مِنْ + هُمَا — min, from (prep.) + 3rd dual pron.; 'from the two of them'
قَلِقًا: qaliqan — qaliq, restless, uneasy, anxious (adj., m., indef. acc.)
لِسَمَاعِ: لِـ + سَمَاعِ — samāʿ, hearing, listening (verbal noun of samiʿa; m., gen.)
الْحَدِيثِ: الـ + حَدِيث — ḥadīth, account, story, talk (m., gen.)
فَأَذِنَ: فَ + أَذِنَ — adhina, to give leave, permit (v. I, perf. 3ms)
وَالْجِنِّيِّ: وَ + الـ + جِنِّيّ — jinniyy, jinni, genie (nisba noun from jinn; m., gen.)
و: wa- — 'and' (the plain coordinating conjunction, printed here as its own space-delimited token, at a line-break, rather than fused to the next word)
َكَرَامَةً: karāma — honor, generosity (f., indef. acc. of manner); ḥubban wa-karāmatan = 'gladly, with pleasure'
وَ: wa- — 'and' (the plain coordinating conjunction, printed here as its own space-delimited token, at a line-break, rather than fused to the next word)
كَرَامَةً: karāma — honor, generosity (f., indef. acc. of manner); ḥubban wa-karāmatan = 'gladly, with pleasure'
اللَّيْلَةُ: الـ + لَيْلَة — layla, night (f., nom.); 'the night'
الْأُولَى: الـ + أُولَى — ūlā, first (f. elative of awwal; nom.); 'the first'
السَّعِيدُ: الـ + سَعِيد — saʿīd, happy, fortunate (adj., m. sg., nom.)
تَاجِرٌ: tājir — merchant (m., nom. indef., subject of kāna)
كَثِيرَ: kathīr — much, abundant (adj., m. sg. acc. as predicate of kāna)

أَحْسَنُ: aḥsanu — aḥsan, better, finer (elative of ḥasan; m. nom., predicate)
أَسْمَنُ: asmanu — asman, fatter (elative of samīn; m. nom.)
فَتَقَدَّمْتُ: فَـ + تَقَدَّمْتُ — fa-, so + taqaddamtu (taqaddama, to step forward, approach; verb V, perf. 1cs); 'so I approached'
لِأَذْبَحَهَا: لِـ + أَذْبَحَ + ـهَا — li-, so that (purposive, governing the subj.) + adhbaḥa (dhabaḥa, to slaughter; verb I, subj. 1cs) + 3fs obj.; 'so that I might slaughter her'
