عَيْشُ: ʿaysh, life/livelihood (m., nom., 1st term of an iḍāfa); 'the life of'
جَرَعَتْهُ: perf. of جَرَعَ (jaraʿa, to give to drink/gulp down), 3fs + ـهُ 'him'; 'it makes him drink'
مُمْسِيًا: active part. of أَمْسَى (amsā, to enter the evening) (acc.); 'at evening'
أَنْعَمُ: elative of نَعِمَ (naʿima, to live in comfort) (m., nom.); 'the most blessed'
الْعَالَمِ: الـ + عَالَم — ʿālam, world (m., gen.); 'the world'
يُجَاهِدُ: Form III imperf. of جَاهَدَ (jāhada, to strive/struggle), 3ms; 'he struggles'
طَلَعَتْ: perf. of طَلَعَ (ṭalaʿa, to rise/come up), 3fs; 'it rose up'
قُمْقُمَ: قُمْقُم — qumqum, jar/flask (m.); 'a jar' (construct, accusative, no tanwīn)
وَفَمُهُ: وَ + فَم + هُ — fam, mouth (m.); -hu, its; 'and its mouth'
مَخْتُومٌ: مَخْتُوم — makhtūm, sealed (passive participle of khatama); 'sealed'
الصَّيَّادُ: الـ + صَيَّاد — ṣayyād, fisherman (intensive noun, m.); 'the fisherman'
أَبِيعُهُ: أَـ + بِعْ + هُ (from بَاعَ) — bāʿa/yabīʿu, to sell (form I, hollow verb); -hu, it; 'I shall sell it'
يُسَاوِي: يُسَاوِي — sāwā/yusāwī, to equal, be worth (form III); 'it is worth'
حَرَّكَهُ: حَرَّكَ + هُ — ḥarraka, to move, shake (form II); -hu, it; 'he moved it'
وَوَجَدَهُ: وَ + وَجَدَ + هُ — wajada, to find; -hu, it; 'and found it'
مَسْدُودًا: مَسْدُود — masdūd, blocked, stopped up (passive participle of sadda); 'stopped up'
أَيْشْ: أَيْش — aysh, what (colloquial/Middle Arabic, contracted from أَيّ شَيْء); 'what'
أَفْتَحُهُ: أَـ + فَتَحَ + هُ — fataḥa, to open; -hu, it; 'let me open it'
وَأَنْظُرُ: وَ + أَنْظُرُ (from نَظَرَ) — naẓara/yanẓuru, to look (form I); 'and let me look'
أَخْرَجَ: أَخْرَجَ — akhraja, to take out, extract (form IV); 'he took out'
وَعَالَجَ: وَ + عَالَجَ — ʿālaja, to work at, apply oneself to (form III); 'and he worked at'
فَكَّهُ: فَكَّ + هُ — fakka, to undo, loosen (form I); -hu, it; 'he loosened it'
وَحَطَّهُ: وَ + حَطَّ + هُ — ḥaṭṭa, to set down, put (form I); -hu, it; 'and he set it down'
وَهَزَّهُ: وَ + هَزَّ + هُ — hazza, to shake (form I); -hu, it; 'and he shook it'
لِيَنْكَبَّ: لِـ + يَنْكَبَّ (from اِنْكَبَّ) — inkabba/yankabbu, to be poured out, overturned (form VII); 'so that it might pour out'
يَنْزِلْ: يَنْزِلْ (from نَزَلَ) — nazala/yanzilu, to come down, descend (form I); 'did it come down'
صَعَدَ: صَعِدَ — ṣaʿida, to rise, ascend (form I); 'it rose'
عَنَانِ: عَنَان — ʿanān, sky, vault, height (m.); 'the vault (of)'
وَمَشَى: وَ + مَشَى — mashā, to walk (form I); 'and it walked'
تَكَامَلَ: تَكَامَلَ — takāmala, to become complete, gather fully (form VI); 'became complete'
وَاِجْتَمَعَ: وَ + اِجْتَمَعَ — ijtamaʿa, to gather together (form VIII); 'and gathered'
وَاِلْتَمَّ: وَ + اِلْتَمَّ (from لَمَّ) — lamma/iltamma, to become whole/complete (form VIII); 'and became whole'
وَاِنْتَفَضَ: وَ + اِنْتَفَضَ — intafaḍa, to shake itself, quiver (form VIII); 'and gave a shudder'
فَصَارَ: فَـ + صَارَ — ṣāra, to become (form I); 'and it became'
عِفْرِينًا: عِفْرِين — ʿifrīn, efrit, a powerful malevolent jinni (variant spelling of عِفْريت); 'an efrit'
رَأْسُهُ: رَأْس + هُ — raʾs, head (m.); -hu, his; 'his head'
وَرِجْلَاهُ: وَ + رِجْلَا + هُ — rijl, leg/foot (f., dual rijlān); -hu, his; 'and his two legs'
التُّرَابِ: الـ + تُرَاب — turāb, dust, earth (m.); 'the dust'
بِرَأْسٍ: بِـ + رَأْس — raʾs, head; 'with a head'
كَالْقُبَّةِ: كَـ + الـ + قُبَّة — qubba, dome (f.); 'like the dome'
بِأَيْدٍ: بِـ + أَيْدٍ (pl. of يَد) — yad, hand (f.), pl. aydin; 'with hands'
كَالْمَدَارِي: كَـ + الـ + مَدَارِي (pl. of مِدْرًى) — midran, a pronged implement, large comb or goad (traditionally rendered 'winnowing-fork'); 'like the winnowing-forks'
بِرِجْلَيْنِ: بِـ + رِجْلَيْنِ — rijl, leg (f., dual); 'with two legs'
كَالسَّوارِي: كَـ + الـ + سَوَارِي (pl. of سَارِيَة) — sāriya, pillar, column (f.); 'like the pillars'
بِفَمٍ: بِـ + فَم — fam, mouth (m.); 'with a mouth'
كَالْمَغَارِ: كَـ + الـ + مَغَار — maghār, cave, cavern (m.); 'like the cavern'
وَأَسْنَانٌ: وَ + أَسْنَان (pl. of سِنّ) — sinn, tooth (f.); 'and teeth'
كَالْحِجَارَةِ: كَـ + الـ + حِجَارَة (pl. of حَجَر) — ḥajar, stone (m.); 'like the stones'
وَمَنَاخِيرُ: وَ + مَنَاخِير (pl. of مِنْخَار) — minkhār, nostril (m.); 'and nostrils'
كَالْإِبْرِيقِ: كَـ + الـ + إِبْرِيق — ibrīq, ewer, long-spouted jug (m., loanword); 'like the ewer'
وَعَيْنَيْنِ: وَ + عَيْنَيْنِ — ʿayn, eye (f., dual); 'and two eyes'
كَأَنَّهُمَا: كَأَنَّ + هُمَا — ka-anna, as though; -humā, they-both; 'as though they were'
سِرَاجَيْنِ: سِرَاجَيْنِ (dual of سِرَاج) — sirāj, lamp (m.); 'two lamps'
اِرْتَعَدَتْ: اِرْتَعَدَ — irtaʿada, to tremble, shudder (form VIII); 'trembled'
فَرَائِصُهُ: فَرَائِص (pl. of فَرِيصَة) + هُ — farīṣa, the flank-muscle that quivers with fear (f.); -hu, his; 'his flanks'
وَتَشَبَّكَتْ: وَ + تَشَبَّكَتْ — tashabbaka, to become interlocked, clench together (form V); 'and clenched together'
أَسْنَانُهُ: أَسْنَان + هُ — sinn, tooth (pl. asnān); -hu, his; 'his teeth'
وَنَشِفَ: وَ + نَشِفَ — nashifa, to dry up (form I); 'and dried up'
رِيقُهُ: رِيق + هُ — rīq, saliva, spittle (m.); -hu, his; 'his saliva'
وَعَمِيَ: وَ + عَمِيَ — ʿamiya, to go blind (form I); 'and he went blind'
طَرِيقِهِ: طَرِيق + هِ — ṭarīq, way, road (m.); -hi, his; 'his way'
إِلٰهَ: إِلٰه — ilāh, god, deity (m.); 'god' (in لا إله إلا الله, 'no god but God')
تَقْتُلْنِي: تَقْتُلْ + نِي (from قَتَلَ) — qatala/yaqtulu, to kill (form I); -nī, me; 'you kill me'
عُدْتُ: عُدْتُ (from عَادَ) — ʿāda/yaʿūdu, to return, go back to (form I, hollow verb); 'I returned/shall again'
أُخَالِفُ: أُخَالِفُ (from خَالَفَ) — khālafa/yukhālifu, to oppose, contradict (form III); 'I contradict'
أَعْصِي: أَعْصِي (from عَصَى) — ʿaṣā/yaʿṣī, to disobey (form I); 'I disobey'
الْمَارِدُ: الـ + مَارِد — mārid, rebellious one, powerful jinni (m.); 'the rebellious one'
نَقُولُ: نَقُولُ (from قَالَ) — qāla/yaqūlu, to say (form I); 'we say'
مُدَّةِ: مُدَّة — mudda, period, span of time (f.); 'a period (of)'
وَثَمَانِمِأْيَةِ: وَ + ثَمَانِمِئَة — thamānimiʾah, eight hundred (compound of thamānī + miʾah; spelled here reflecting the colloquial pronunciation 'miyya'); 'and eight hundred'
قِصَّتُكَ: قِصَّة + كَ — qiṣṣa, story (f.); -ka, your; 'your story'
حَدِيثُكَ: حَدِيث + كَ — ḥadīth, account, narrative (m.); -ka, your; 'your account'
دُخُولِكَ: دُخُول + كَ — dukhūl, entering (verbal noun of dakhala); -ka, your; 'your entering'
أَبْشِرْ: أَبْشِرْ (from بَشَّرَ) — bashshara/abshara, to give glad tidings; imperative form IV: 'be glad, rejoice'; 'rejoice!'
تُبَشِّرُنِي: تُبَشِّرُ + نِي (from بَشَّرَ) — bashshara/yubashshiru, to give good news (form II); -nī, me; 'do you give me good news'
بِقَتْلِكَ: بِـ + قَتْل + كَ — qatl, killing (m.); -ka, your; 'with your killing'
قِتْلَةٍ: قِتْلَة — qitla, a manner/kind of killing (f.); 'a killing'
تَسْتَأْهِلُ: تَسْتَأْهِلُ (from أَهْل) — istaʾhala/yastaʾhilu, to deserve (form X; Middle Arabic/colloquial verb beside Classical تَسْتَحِقّ); 'you deserve'
الْبِشَارَةِ: الـ + بِشَارَة — bishāra, good news, glad tidings (f.); 'the good news'
قَيِّمَ: قَيِّم — qayyim, keeper, warden, one in charge (m.); 'warden (of)'
الْعَفَارِيتِ: الـ + عَفَارِيت (pl. of عِفْريت) — ʿifrīt, efrit; 'the efrits'
بِزَوَالِ: بِـ + زَوَال — zawāl, departure, removal, cessation (m.); 'with the departure (of)'
السِّتْرِ: الـ + سِتْر — sitr, veil, covering, protection (m.); 'the veil/covering'
عَنْكَ: عَنْ + كَ — ʿan, from; -ka, you; 'from you'
بَعِيدُ: بَعِيد — baʿīd, far/distant (adj., used substantively); 'you far one!' (an exclamation of scorn/incredulity)
لِأَيِّ: لِـ + أَيّ — ayy, which?/what? (interrogative noun); 'for what'
تَقْتُلُنِي: تَقْتُلُ + نِي — qatala/yaqtulu, to kill; 'you kill me'
يُوجِبُ: يُوجِبُ — awjaba/yūjibu (Form IV of وجب), to necessitate, make obligatory
خَلَّصْتُكَ: خَلَّصْتُ + كَ — khallaṣa/yukhalliṣu (Form II of خلص), to free, rescue; 'I freed you'
قَرَارِ: قَرَار — qarār, bottom, resting-place (m.); here mudāf, 'bottom of'
تَمَنَّ: تَمَنَّ — imperative of tamannā/yatamannā (Form V of مني), to wish, desire; here 'name your wish (to me)'
أَيَّ: أَيّ — ayy, which (interrogative/indefinite noun, here accusative of specification)
مَوْتَةٍ: مَوْتَة — mawta, a death, an instance of dying (f.); from موت, to die
تُقْتَلُ: تُقْتَلُ — passive of qatala/yaqtulu, to kill; 'you are killed'
ذَنْبِي: ذَنْب + ي — dhanb, sin, offence, fault (m.); 'my fault'
جَزَائِي: جَزَاء + ي — jazāʾ, recompense, requital (m.); 'my recompense'
اسْمَعْ: اسْمَعْ — imperative of samiʿa/yasmaʿu, to hear, listen; 'listen!'
وَأَوْجِزْ: وَ + أَوْجِزْ — imperative of awjaza/yūjizu (Form IV of وجز), to be brief, concise; 'and be brief'
رُوحِي: رُوح + ي — rūḥ, soul, spirit (f.); 'my soul'
وَصَلَتْ: وَصَلَتْ — waṣalat, fem. of waṣala/yaṣilu, to arrive, reach; 'it (f.) has reached'
أَنْفِي: أَنْف + ي — anf, nose (m.); 'my nose' — 'my soul has reached my nose' is an idiom for being at one's very last gasp
الْجِنِّ: الـ + جِنّ — jinn, the jinn, spirits (m. pl. collective)
الْمَارِقِينَ: الـ + مَارِقِين — māriq (pl. māriqūn/māriqīn), one who bolts/breaks away, rebels, apostatizes (active participle of مرق); here 'the rebellious ones', i.e. the jinn who defied Solomon
عَصَيْتُ: عَصَيْتُ — ʿaṣā/yaʿṣī, to disobey, rebel against; 'I disobeyed'
بْنَ: بْنَ — ibn, son (of) (m.); medial form of the name-linking 'son of'
وَصَخْرٌ: وَ + صَخْرٌ — Ṣakhr, a jinni of Solomonic legend said to have impersonated the king (proper name)
أَٰصِفَ: آصِف — Āṣif (b. Barkhiyā), Solomon's legendary vizier (proper name; the edition prints a plain alif, so the initial long ā is restored editorially alongside the hamza)
بَرْخِيَا: بَرْخِيَا — Barkhiyā, father's name of Āṣif, Solomon's vizier (proper name, indeclinable)
كَرْهًا: كَرْه — karh, unwillingness, compulsion (m., accusative of manner); 'by compulsion'
وَقَادَنِي: وَ + قَادَ + نِي — qāda/yaqūdu, to lead; 'and he led me'
رَغْمِ: رَغْم — raghm, spite, reluctance (m.); عَلَى رَغْمِ أَنْفِهِ 'in spite of his nose' is the standard idiom for being forced against one's will
وَأَوْقَفَنِي: وَ + أَوْقَفَ + نِي — awqafa/yūqifu (Form IV of وقف), to make stand, halt; 'and he made me stand'
اسْتَعَاذَ: اسْتَعَاذَ — istaʿādha/yastaʿīdhu (Form X of عوذ), to seek refuge (with God); 'he sought refuge'
وَأَعْرَضَ: وَ + أَعْرَضَ — aʿraḍa/yuʿriḍu (Form IV of عرض), to present, offer, propose; 'and he offered/proposed'
الْإِيمَانَ: الـ + إِيمَان — īmān, faith, belief (m., verbal noun of Form IV آمن)
وَالدَّخُولَ: وَ + الـ + دُّخُول — dukhūl, entering (m., verbal noun of دخل); 'and the entering'
فَأَبَيْتُ: فَ + أَبَيْتُ — abā/yaʾbā, to refuse; 'but I refused'
فَدَعَا: فَ + دَعَا — daʿā/yadʿū, to call (for); 'so he called for'
وَحَبَسَنِي: وَ + حَبَسَ + نِي — ḥabasa/yaḥbisu, to imprison, confine; 'and he imprisoned me'
وَخَتَمَ: وَ + خَتَمَ — khatama/yakhtimu, to seal; 'and he sealed'
بِالرَّصَاصِ: بِـ + الـ + رَّصَاص — raṣāṣ, lead (the metal, m.)
وَطَبَعَهُ: وَ + طَبَعَ + هُ — ṭabaʿa/yaṭbaʿu, to stamp, imprint; 'and he stamped it'
بِالْاسْمِ: بِـ + الـ + اسْم — ism, name (m.); 'with the Name'
الْأَعْظَمِ: الـ + أَعْظَم — aʿẓam, greatest (elative of عظيم, diptote); the Greatest Name (of God), by which jinn are bound
الْجِنَّ: الـ + جِنّ — jinn, the jinn (accusative, object of أمر)
فَاحْتَمَلُونِي: فَ + احْتَمَلُوا + نِي — iḥtamala/yaḥtamilu (Form VIII of حمل), to carry, bear; 'so they carried me'
وَأَلْقَوْنِي: وَ + أَلْقَوْا + نِي — alqā/yulqī (Form IV of لقي), to throw, cast; 'and they threw me'
فَأَقَمْتُ: فَ + أَقَمْتُ — aqāma/yuqīmu (Form IV of قوم), to stay, remain; 'so I remained'
خَلَّصَنِي: خَلَّصَ + نِي — khallaṣa/yukhalliṣu (Form II of خلص), to free; 'frees/freed me'
أَغْنَيْتُهُ: أَغْنَيْتُ + هُ — aghnā/yughnī (Form IV of غني), to make rich, enrich; 'I enrich him'
فَمَرَّتْ: فَ + مَرَّتْ — marrat, fem. of marra/yamurru, to pass; 'it (f.) passed'
يُخَلِّصْنِي: يُخَلِّصْ + نِي — khallaṣa/yukhalliṣu (Form II of خلص), to free; jussive after لم; 'he frees/would free me'
أُخْرَى: أُخْرَى — ukhrā, other, another (fem. of آخَر)
كُنُوزَ: كُنُوز — kanz (pl. kunūz), treasure, hoard (m.); 'the treasures of'
فَمَرَّ: فَ + مَرَّ — marra/yamurru, to pass; 'so it passed'
أَٰخَرَ: آخَر — ākhar, other, another (m., diptote; the edition prints a plain alif for the initial hamza + long ā, restored editorially with the dagger alif)
أَقْضِي: أَقْضِي — qaḍā/yaqḍī, to fulfil, grant, settle; 'I grant/fulfil'
ثَلَاثَ: ثَلَاثَ — thalātha, three (f. numeral, accusative, mudāf)
فَغَضِبْتُ: فَ + غَضِبْتُ — ghaḍiba/yaghḍabu, to become angry; 'so I became angry'
غَضَبًا: غَضَبًا — ghaḍab, anger (m., accusative of the cognate/absolute object); 'a(n) (violent) anger'
وَمَنَّيْتُهُ: وَ + مَنَّيْتُ + هُ — mannā/yumannī (Form II of مني), to make wish, grant a wish/choice; 'and I would grant him the choice'
خَلَّصْتَنِي: خَلَّصْتَ + نِي — khallaṣa/yukhalliṣu (Form II of خلص), to free; 'you freed me'
وَمَنَّيْتُكَ: وَ + مَنَّيْتُ + كَ — mannā/yumannī (Form II of مني), to grant a wish/choice; 'and I grant you the choice'
لَلَّهِ: لَـ + اللَّه — Allāh, God, with the exclamatory lām of invocation (لام الاستغاثة); 'O God!/By God!'
الْعَجَبُ: الـ + عَجَب — ʿajab, wonder, astonishment (m.); 'the wonder (of it)!'
أُخَلِّصَكَ: أُخَلِّصَ + كَ — khallaṣa/yukhalliṣu (Form II of خلص), to free; subjunctive after جئت (purpose); 'to free you'
مِائَهَ: مِائَة — miʾa, a hundred (f., accusative); the edition spells the word مايه (plain يا for the hamza-bearing ya, and ه for ة), preserved here as printed
مِائَهٍ: مِائَة — miʾa, a hundred (f., genitive after عَلَى); spelled مايه as printed (see idx 73 note)
مِائَهُ: مِائَة — miʾa, a hundred (f., nominative here, subject of مرّت); spelled مايه as printed (see idx 73 note)
أَرْبَعُمِائَهِ: أَرْبَعُ + مِائَة — arbaʿumiʾa, four hundred (compound number; مائة spelled مايه as printed)
وَأَيَّ: وَ + أَيّ — ayy, which (interrogative/indefinite noun, accusative); 'and which'
وَأَيُّ: وَ + أَيّ — ayy, which?/what? (interrogative noun, nominative); 'and what'
لِلْعِفْرِيتِ: لِـ + الـ + عِفْرِيت — ʿifrīt, efrit, a powerful and cunning jinni (m., gen.)
اعْفُ: عَفَا — ʿafā, to forgive, pardon (verb I defective, imper. 2ms, hamzat-wasl left unmarked); 'forgive!'
يَعْفُ: يَعْفُ — yaʿfu, jussive of ʿafā, to forgive (verb I defective, imperf. 3ms jussive, as the response to a request); 'may he forgive'
تُهْلِكْنِي: تُهْلِكْ + ـنِي — tuhlik, neg. imper. jussive of ahlaka, to destroy (verb IV, imperf. 2ms) + 1cs; 'do not destroy me'
يُسَلِّطِ: يُسَلِّطِ — yusalliṭ(i), jussive of sallaṭa, to give power/dominion over (verb II, imperf. 3ms, response to a request; -i is a helper vowel before the following al-)
يُهْلِكُكَ: يُهْلِكُ + ـكَ — yuhliku, imperf. 3ms of ahlaka, to destroy (verb IV) + 2ms; 'he will destroy you'
فَتَمَنَّ: فَ + تَمَنَّ — fa-, so + tamanna, imper. of tamannā, to wish, to make a wish known (verb V, apocopated); with ʿalā, 'to invite (someone) to state a wish'
تَمُوتُهَا: تَمُوتُ + ـهَا — tamūtu, imperf. 2ms of māta, to die (verb I hollow) + resumptive f. obj. pron. (referring back to mawtatin, its own cognate object); 'you die it'
تَحَقَّقَ: تَحَقَّقَ — taḥaqqaqa, to become certain, be verified (verb V, perf. 3ms)
رَاجَعَ: رَاجَعَ — rājaʿa, to appeal to again, address once more (verb III, perf. 3ms)
إِكْرَامًا: إِكْرَامًا — ikrāman, as an act of generosity, out of graciousness (m., acc. of manner, maṣdar of akrama)
أَعْتَقْتُكَ: أَعْتَقْتُ + ـكَ — aʿtaqtu, perf. 1cs of aʿtaqa, to free, manumit (verb IV) + 2ms; 'I freed you' (printed rasm — see the note at unit 85 on its inverted sense)
أَقْتُلُكَ: أَقْتُلُ + ـكَ — aqtulu, imperf. 1cs of qatala, to kill (verb I) + 2ms; 'I kill you'
لِأَجْلِ: لِـ + أَجْلِ — li-, for + ajl, sake, reason (m., gen.); li-ajli mā, 'for the sake of that which, because'
شَيْخَ: شَيْخَ — shaykh, elder, chief, head (m., acc., first term of a vocative iḍāfa)
أَصْنَعُ: أَصْنَعُ — aṣnaʿu, imperf. 1cs of ṣanaʿa, to do, make (verb I); 'I do'
مَلِيًّا: مَلِيًّا — maliyyan, lit. 'for a long while' or '(one) of substance' (m., acc. adv.); non-standard in this idiom, see the note at unit 86
تُقَابِلُنِي: تُقَابِلُ + ـنِي — tuqābilu, imperf. 2ms of qābala, to meet, face, requite (verb III) + 1cs; 'you meet me, you requite me'
بِالْقَبِيحِ: بِـ + الـ + قَبِيح — qabīḥ, foul, ugly, wicked (m., gen.); 'with foulness'
يَكْذِبِ: يَكْذِبِ — yakdhib(i), jussive of kadhaba, to lie, be false (verb I, imperf. 3ms; -i is a helper vowel before al-)
الْمَثَلُ: الـ + مَثَل — mathal, proverb, saying (m., nom.)
الشِّعْرَ: الـ + شِعْر — shiʿr, poetry, verse (m., acc.)
تُطِلْ: تُطِلْ — tuṭil, neg. imper. jussive of aṭāla, to prolong (verb IV, imperf. 2ms); 'do not prolong'
فَلَابُدَّ: فَ + لَا بُدَّ — fa-, so + lā budda (min), there is no escape (from)
مَوْتِكَ: مَوْت + ـِكَ — mawt, death (m., gen.) + 2ms; 'your death'
جِنِّيٌّ: جِنِّيٌّ — jinniyy, a jinnī, one of the jinn-kind (m., nisba noun from jinn, nom. indef.)
إِنْسِيٌّ: إِنْسِيٌّ — insiyy, a human being (m., nisba noun from ins, nom. indef.)
أَعْطَانِيَ: أَعْطَانِيَ — aʿṭāniya, perf. 3ms of aʿṭā, to give (verb IV defective) + 1cs obj. (-niya before a following hamzat-wasl word); 'he gave me'
عَقْلًا: عَقْلًا — ʿaqlan, a mind, an intellect, reason (m., acc. indef.)
كَامِلًا: كَامِلًا — kāmilan, complete, perfect (m., acc. indef., act. part. of kamala)
أُدَبِّرُ: أُدَبِّرُ — udabbiru, imperf. 1cs of dabbara, to scheme, contrive, plot (verb II); 'I scheme'
هَلَاكِهِ: هَلَاك + ـِهِ — halāk, destruction, ruin (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'his destruction'
بِحِيلَتِي: بِـ + حِيلَة + ـِي — bi-, with + ḥīla, stratagem, trick (f., gen.) + 1cs; 'with my stratagem'
وَبِعَقْلِي: وَ + بِـ + عَقْل + ـِي — wa-, and + bi-, with + ʿaql, mind, intellect (m., gen.) + 1cs; 'and with my mind'
يُدَبِّرُ: يُدَبِّرُ — yudabbiru, imperf. 3ms of dabbara, to scheme, plot (verb II); 'he schemes'
بِمَكْرِهِ: بِـ + مَكْر + ـِهِ — bi-, with + makr, guile, cunning (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'with his guile'
وَخُبْثِهِ: وَ + بِـ + خُبْث + ـِهِ — wa-, and + bi-, with + khubth, malice, wickedness (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'and with his malice'
بِالِاسْمِ: بِـ + الـ + اِسْم — ism, name (m., gen.); 'by the Name'
الْمَنْقُوشِ: الـ + مَنْقُوش — manqūsh, engraved, inscribed (m., pass. part. of naqasha, gen.)
أَسْأَلُكَ: أَسْأَلُ + ـكَ — asʾalu, imperf. 1cs of saʾala, to ask (verb I) + 2ms; 'I ask you'
شَيٍ: شَيْءٍ — shayʾ, a thing (m., gen. indef.); printed without the hamza letter itself, a colloquial spelling, read shayʾin
وَتُصَدِّقُنِي: وَ + تُصَدِّقُ + ـنِي — wa-, and + tuṣaddiqu, imperf. 2ms of ṣaddaqa, to confirm as true (verb II) + 1cs; 'and you confirm to me'
ذِكْرَ: ذِكْرَ — dhikr, mention, remembrance (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
اضْطَرَبَ: اِضْطَرَبَ — iḍṭaraba, to be agitated, thrown into turmoil (verb VIII of ḍaraba, perf. 3ms)
سَلْ: سَلْ — sal, ask! (irregular imper. of saʾala, to ask; the medial hamza is dropped)
وَالْقُمْقُمُ: وَ + الـ + قُمْقُم — wa-, and + qumqum, jar, flask (m., nom.)
يَسَعُ: يَسَعُ — yasaʿu, imperf. 3ms of wasiʿa, to hold, contain, have room for (verb I assimilated)
يَدَكَ: يَد + ـكَ — yad, hand (f., acc.) + 2ms; 'your hand'
رِجْلَكَ: رِجْل + ـكَ — rijl, foot, leg (f., acc.) + 2ms; 'your foot'
يَسَعُكَ: يَسَعُ + ـكَ — yasaʿu, imperf. 3ms of wasiʿa, to hold, contain (verb I) + 2ms; 'it holds you'
تُصَدِّقُ: تُصَدِّقُ — tuṣaddiqu, imperf. 2ms of ṣaddaqa, to believe, accept as true (verb II)
أَنَّنِي: أَنَّنِي — annanī, that I (anna, 'that', + 1cs; extended variant of annī)
أُصَدِّقُكَ: أُصَدِّقُ + ـكَ — uṣaddiqu, imperf. 1cs of ṣaddaqa, to believe (verb II) + 2ms; 'I believe you'
أَنْظُرَكَ: أَنْظُرُ + ـكَ — anẓuru, imperf. 1cs (subjunctive after ḥattā) of naẓara, to see, look (verb I) + 2ms; 'I see you'
يَفْعَلِ: يَفْعَلِ — yafʿal(i), jussive of faʿala, to do (verb I, imperf. 3ms, conditional after man; -i is a helper vowel before al-)
الْمَعْرُوفَ: الـ + مَعْرُوف — maʿrūf, a good deed, kindness, that which is fitting (m., pass. part. of ʿarafa, acc.)
غَيْرِ: غَيْرِ — ghayr, other than, not (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
اَهْلِهِ: أَهْل + ـهِ — ahl, people, those fit for/deserving of (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'those deserving of it' (edition's own pointing, printed here unchanged)
يُجَازَى: يُجَازَى — yujāzā, passive imperf. 3ms of jāzā (verb III), to repay, requite; 'he is repaid'
مُجِيرُ: مُجِيرُ — mujīr, one who grants protection or refuge (m., act. part. of ajāra, verb IV; nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
اُمِّ: أُمِّ — umm, mother (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); in Umm ʿĀmir, a traditional byname for the hyena
عَامِرِ: عَامِرِ — ʿĀmir, a man's proper name (gen.); here the second term of the byname Umm ʿĀmir, 'the hyena'
الرَّابِعَةُ: الـ + رَابِعَة — rābiʿ, fourth (ordinal adj., f. sg. nom.); 'the fourth [night]'
كُنْتِ: كُنْ + تِ — kāna, to be, perf. 2f.sg.; 'you (f.) were/are'
نَايِمَةٍ: نَايِمَة — nāʾima, asleep (f. sg. indef. gen., mudāf ilayh of غَيْر); medial hamza after ā written as bare يَاء, cf. زَايِد/زَائِد
دُخَانًا: دُخَانًا — dukhān, smoke (m., acc. as predicate of صَارَ, tanwīn fatḥa); 'smoke'
الْقُمْقُمَ: الـ + قُمْقُم — qumqum, jar, flask (m., acc. as direct obj. of place); 'the jar'
اِسْتَكْمَلَ: اِسْتَكْمَلَ — istakmala (form X, 'to become wholly complete'), perf. 3m.sg.; 'was completed'
بِالصَّيَّادِ: بِـ + الـ + صَيَّاد — bi-, with/by + al-ṣayyād, the fisherman (gen. after بِ in the وَإِذَا بِـ construction of surprise); 'and then, [there was] the fisherman'
أَسْرَعَ: أَسْرَعَ — asraʿa (form IV of سرع), perf. 3m.sg.; 'he made haste, hurried'
سِدَادَةَ: سِدَادَةَ — sidāda, stopper, plug (f., acc., mudāf to الرَّصَاص); 'the stopper of'
الْمَخْتُومَةَ: الـ + مَخْتُومَة — makhtūm, sealed, stamped (pass. part. of خَتَمَ, f. sg. acc. adj.); 'the sealed one'
وَطَبَعَهَا: وَ + طَبَعَ + هَا — ṭabaʿa, to stamp, press, imprint, perf. 3m.sg. + hā, it (f., i.e. the stopper); 'and he pressed it'
فَمِ: فَمِ — fam, mouth (m., gen., mudāf to الْقُمْقُم); 'the mouth of'
وَنَادَى: وَ + نَادَى — nādā (form III), 'to call out to', perf. 3m.sg.; 'and he called out'
لَأَرْمِيَنَّكَ: لَـ + أَرْمِيَنَّ + كَ — la-, verily (emphatic lām) + ramā, to throw, 1sg. energetic impf. + ka, you; 'I will surely throw you' (hamza supplied as combining mark; the doubled energetic نّ is a diacritic our vocalisation supplies over the bare rasm's single ن)
وَأَبْنِي: وَ + أَبْنِي — banā, to build, 1sg. impf.; 'and I will build' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare وابني)
لِى: لِى — li, to/for (prep.) + ī, me; 'for myself' (the edition spells the final long ī with alif maqṣūra ى rather than dotted يَاء, a variant spelling kept as printed; distinct from the more usual لِي)
بَيْتًا: بَيْتًا — bayt, house (m., acc. as obj. of أَبْنِي, tanwīn fatḥa); 'a house'
أَمْنَعُهُ: أَمْنَعُ + هُ — manaʿa, to prevent, forbid, 1sg. impf. + hu, him; 'I forbid him' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare امنعه)
يَصْطَادَ: يَصْطَادَ — iṣṭāda (form VIII of صيد), 3m.sg. subj. (after أَنْ); 'that he fish'
وَأَقُولُ: وَ + أَقُولُ — qāla, to say, 1sg. impf.; 'and I will say' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare واقول)
عِفْرِيتٌ: عِفْرِيتٌ — ʿifrīt, efrit, powerful jinni (m., indef. nom. as predicate); 'an efrit'
يُمَنِّيهِ: يُمَنِّي + هِ — mannā (form II of منى/تمنّى), 'to make someone entertain fancies/false hopes', 3m.sg. impf. + hi, him; 'it fills him with fancies'
يَقْتُلُهُ: يَقْتُلُ + هُ — qatala, to kill, 3m.sg. impf. + hu, him; 'it will kill him'
مَحْبُوسًا: مَحْبُوسًا — maḥbūs, imprisoned, confined (pass. part. of حَبَسَ, m. sg. acc. as predicate of رَأَى); 'imprisoned'
الْخُرُوجَ: الـ + خُرُوج — khurūj, going out, exiting (verbal noun of خَرَجَ, m., acc. as obj. of أَرَادَ); 'the going-out'
خَاتَمُ: خَاتَمُ — khātam, seal, signet (m., nom. as subject of مَنَعَ, mudāf to سُلَيْمَان); 'the seal of'
وَعَلِمَ: وَ + عَلِمَ — ʿalima, to know, perf. 3m.sg.; 'and he knew'
تَحَايَلَ: تَحَايَلَ — taḥāyala (form VI of حيل), 'to use guile, contrive a trick', perf. 3m.sg.; 'he had used a trick'
أَمْزَحُ: أَمْزَحُ — mazaḥa, to joke, jest, 1sg. impf.; 'I am joking' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare امزح)
تَلْعَبُ: تَلْعَبُ — laʿiba, to play, jest, 2m.sg. impf.; 'do you jest?'
الْعَفَارِيتَ: الـ + عَفَارِيت — ʿafārīt, efrits (broken pl. of عِفْرِيت, m., acc. as obj. of أَحْضِرِ); 'the efrits'
وَأَحْضِرْهَا: وَ + أَحْضِرْ + هَا — aḥḍara (form IV of حضر) imper. 2m.sg. + hā, them (f., referring to الْعَفَارِيت); 'and bring them' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare واحضرها)
وَاخْتِمْهَا: وَ + اِخْتِمْ + هَا — khatama (form I) imper. 2m.sg. (hamzat waṣl) + hā, them; 'and seal them'
إِي: إِي — ī, yes, indeed (affirmative particle); hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare اي; not to be confused with أَيّ, 'which'
وَرَمَقَ: وَ + رَمَقَ — ramaqa (form I), 'to glance at with a faint/lingering look', perf. 3m.sg.; 'and he glanced'
الْبَارِدُ: الـ + بَارِد — bārid, cold (act. part. of بَرَدَ, m. sg. nom., epithet used of the efrit here); word of uncertain sense in this passage, see note
كُمَّهُ: كُمَّ + هُ — kumm, sleeve (m., acc.) + hu, his; 'his sleeve'
وَحَضَمَ: وَ + حَضَمَ — ḥaḍama, perf. 3m.sg. of an obscure/uncertain root, possibly corrupt; see note
تَصْنَعُ: تَصْنَعُ — ṣanaʿa, to make, do, 2m.sg. impf.; 'you do/make' (here without أَنْ before it, paratactic)
أَقَمْتُ: أَقَمْتُ — aqāma (form IV of قوم), 'to dwell, reside', perf. 1sg.; 'I dwelt' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare اقمت)
وَثَمَانَمِائَةَ: وَ + ثَمَانَمِائَة — thamānmiʾa, eight hundred (compound numeral, acc.); the medial hamza is printed precomposed (ئ) in the archive and kept as given
سَنَهٍ: سَنَهٍ — sana, year (f. sg. indef. gen., mudāf ilayh of the compound number); the edition writes tāʾ marbūṭa as plain hāʾ
فَأَنَا: فَـ + أَنَا — fa-, so/then + anā, I; 'so I' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare فانا)
أُخَلِّيكَ: أُخَلِّي + كَ — khallā (form II of خلي/خلو), 'to leave, let be', 1sg. impf. + ka, you; 'I leave you' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare اخليك)
تَقُومَ: تَقُومَ — qāma, to rise, stand, 3f.sg. subj. (after أَنْ); 'that it/she [the Hour] rise'
السَّاعَةُ: الـ + سَاعَة — sāʿa, hour (f. sg. nom. as subject of تَقُومَ); 'the Hour' (i.e. the Last Hour, Judgement)
أَبْقِنِي: أَبْقِ + نِي — abqā (form IV of بقي), 'to keep, preserve alive', imper. 2m.sg. + nī, me; 'spare me, keep me alive' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare ابقني)
يُبْقِكَ: يُبْقِ + كَ — abqā (form IV), 3m.sg. juss. (jussive of request/result) + ka, you; 'may He keep you alive'
فَأَبَيْتَ: فَـ + أَبَيْتَ — abā, to refuse, 2m.sg. perf. + fa-, so/but; 'so you refused' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare فابيت; distinct from the 1sg. فَأَبَيْتُ, 'so I refused')
تَغْدِرَ: تَغْدِرَ — ghadara, to betray, act treacherously, 2m.sg. subj. (after أَنْ); 'that you betray'
فَأَرْمَاكَ: فَـ + أَرْمَى + كَ — armā (form IV of رمي), 'to cast down, deliver over', perf. 3m.sg. + ka, you; 'so He cast you down' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare فارماك)
فَغَدَرْتُ: فَـ + غَدَرْتُ — ghadara, to betray, 1sg. perf.; 'so I dealt treacherously'
أُحْسِنَ: أُحْسِنَ — aḥsana (form IV of حسن), 'to do good, show kindness', 1sg. subj. (after حَتَّى); 'that I may show kindness' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare احسن; distinct from the elative adj. أَحْسَن, 'better')
مِثْلِي: مِثْل + ي — mithl, likeness (m.) + ī, my; 'my likeness'
مَلْعُونُ: مَلْعُونُ — malʿūn, accursed, cursed (pass. part. of لَعَنَ, m. sg. nom. as vocative); 'O accursed one'
تَكْذِبُ: تَكْذِبُ — kadhaba, to lie, 2m.sg. impf.; 'you lie'
وَزِيرِ: وَزِيرِ — wazīr, vizier, minister (m., gen., mudāf); 'the vizier of' (distinct from the nom. وَزِيرُ already keyed)
يُونَانَ: يُونَانَ — Yūnān, Yunan (proper noun, diptote, gen./acc.); the King's name
دُوبَانَ: دُوبَانَ — Dūbān, Duban (proper noun, diptote, gen./acc.); the sage's name
قِصَّتُهُمَا: قِصَّة + هُمَا — qiṣṣa, story (f., nom.) + humā, their (dual); 'their story'
أَرَدْتَ: أَرَدْتَ — arāda (form IV of رود), 'to want, intend', 2m.sg. perf.; 'you wanted' (hamza supplied as combining mark, archive bare واردت; distinct from the 1sg. وَأَرَدْتُ)
وَمِثْلُكَ: وَ + مِثْل + كَ — wa-, and + mithl, likeness (m., nom.) + ka, your; 'and your likeness'
وَالْحَكِيمِ: وَ + الـ + حَكِيم — wa-, and + al-ḥakīm, the sage, wise man (m., gen.); 'and the sage'
الْفُرْسِ: الـ + فُرْس — Furs, the Persians (collective pl., m., gen.)
وَأَرْضِ: وَ + أَرْض — arḍ, land, earth (f., gen.); 'and the land of'
رُومَانَ: Rūmān, a name for the land/people of the Byzantines-Greeks (proper n., gen., diptote)
يُونَانُ: Yūnān, personal name of the king (also the word for 'Greece, Ionia'; proper n., nom., diptote)
وَجُنُودٌ: وَ + جُنُود — jund, troop, army (m. pl., nom. indef.)
وَهَيْبَةٌ: وَ + هَيْبَة — hayba, awe, majesty (f., nom. indef.)
وَأَعْوَانٌ: وَ + أَعْوَان — ʿawn, helper (m. pl., nom. indef.)
سَائِرِ: sāʾir, the rest (of), all (of) (act. part. of sāra used idiomatically as a quasi-noun; gen., first term of iḍāfa)
الْأَجْنَاسِ: الـ + أَجْنَاس — jins, race, kind, sort (m. pl., gen.)
جَسَدِهِ: جَسَد + ـهِ — jasad, body (m., gen.) + 3ms pron.; 'his body'
بَرَصٌ: baraṣ, a whitening of the skin (leukoderma/vitiligo, sometimes rendered 'leprosy') (m., nom. indef.)
أَعْيَى: aʿyā, form IV of ʿayiya, 'to weary, exhaust, defeat' (3ms past)
الْأَطِبَّاءَ: الـ + أَطِبَّاء — ṭabīb, physician (m. pl., acc.)
وَالْحُكَمَاءَ: وَ + الـ + حُكَمَاء — ḥakīm, sage (m. pl., acc.)
أَدْوِيَةً: adwiya, medicines (pl. of dawāʾ, f./m., acc. indef.)
وَسُفُوفًا: وَ + سُفُوفًا — sufūf, medicinal powder taken dry (m. pl., acc. indef.)
وَدِهَانًا: وَ + دِهَانًا — dihān, ointment, liniment (m., acc. indef.)
يَنْفَعْهُ: yanfaʿ + ـهُ — nafaʿa, 'to profit, benefit' (juss. after lam) + 3ms obj.; 'it profited him'
الْأَطِبَّاءِ: الـ + أَطِبَّاء — ṭabīb, physician (m. pl., gen.)
يُبْرِئَهُ: yubriʾa + ـهُ — abraʾa, form IV of baraʾa, 'to cure, heal' (subj. after an) + 3ms obj.; 'that he cure him'
حَكِيمٌ: ḥakīm, sage, learned man (m., nom. indef.)
طَاعِنٌ: ṭāʿin, thrusting; idiomatically (ṭāʿin fī al-sinn) 'advanced in years' (act. part. of ṭaʿana, nom. indef.)
الْحَكِيمُ: الـ + حَكِيم — ḥakīm, sage (m., nom.); here as a title, 'the sage'
دُوبَانُ: Dūbān, personal name of the sage (proper n., nom.)
الْيُونَانِيَّةَ: الـ + يُونَانِيَّة — Yūnānī, Greek (rel. adj., f. sg., acc.)
وَالْفَارِسِيَّةَ: وَ + الـ + فَارِسِيَّة — Fārisī, Persian (rel. adj., f. sg., acc.)

الطِّبَّ: الـ + طِبّ — ṭibb, medicine (the science of) (m., acc.)
وَالنُّجُومَ: وَ + الـ + نُجُوم — najm, star (m. pl., acc.); here 'astronomy/astrology'
تَأْسِيسَ: taʾsīs, founding, establishing (masdar of assasa, form II, acc.); the printed rasm has plain alif for this hamza, which we mark with a combining hamza
حِكْمَتِهَا: حِكْمَة + ـهَا — ḥikma, wisdom, lore (f., gen.) + 3fs pron. (referring to al-nujūm, 'the stars/astrology')
وَقَوَاعِدَ: وَ + قَوَاعِد — qāʿida, rule, principle (f. pl., acc.)
أُمُورِهَا: أُمُور + ـهَا — amr, affair, matter (m. pl., gen.) + 3fs pron.
وَمَنْفَعَتَهَا: وَ + مَنْفَعَة + ـهَا — manfaʿa, benefit, use (f., acc.) + 3fs pron.
وَمَضَرَّتَهَا: وَ + مَضَرَّة + ـهَا — maḍarra, harm (f., acc.) + 3fs pron.
النَّبَاتَاتِ: الـ + نَبَاتَات — nabāt, plant (f. pl., gen.)
وَالْحَشَائِشِ: وَ + الـ + حَشَائِش — ḥashīsh, grass, herbage (m. pl., gen.)
وَالْأَعْشَابِ: وَ + الـ + أَعْشَاب — ʿushb, herb (m. pl., gen.)
الْمُضِرَّةِ: الـ + مُضِرَّة — muḍirr, harmful (act. part. IV of ḍarra, f. sg., gen.)
وَالنَّافِعَةِ: وَ + الـ + نَافِعَة — nāfiʿ, beneficial (act. part. I of nafaʿa, f. sg., gen.)
الْفَلَاسِفَةَ: الـ + فَلَاسِفَة — faylasūf, philosopher (m. pl., acc.)
وَحَازَ: وَ + حَازَ — ḥāza, 'to gain, encompass, possess' (3ms past)
الْعُلُومِ: الـ + عُلُوم — ʿilm, science, branch of knowledge (m. pl., gen.)
الطِّبِّيَّةِ: الـ + طِبِّيَّة — ṭibbī, medical (rel. adj., f. sg., gen.)
وَغَيْرَهَا: وَ + غَيْر + ـهَا — ghayr, other (than) (acc.) + 3fs pron.; 'and others besides it'
الْحَكِيمَ: الـ + حَكِيم — ḥakīm, sage (m., acc.); 'the sage'
قَلَائِلَ: qalāʾil, few (broken pl. adj. of qalīl, acc., diptote)
بَدَنِهِ: بَدَن + ـهِ — badan, body (m., gen.) + 3ms pron.
اِبْتَلَاهُ: اِبْتَلَى + ـهُ — ibtalā, form VIII of balā/balaya, 'to try, afflict' (3ms past; hamzat waṣl, no hamza mark) + 3ms obj.
عَجَزَتْ: ʿajazat, 'to be powerless, unable' (3fs past; fem. agreement with the human broken pl. al-aṭibbāʾ, permitted for broken plurals in Classical Arabic)
مُدَاوَاتِهِ: مُدَاوَاة + ـهِ — mudāwāh, treating, medical treatment (masdar III of dāwā, f., gen.) + 3ms pron.
الْأَطِبَّاءُ: الـ + أَطِبَّاء — ṭabīb, physician (m. pl., nom.)
وَأَكْمَلَ: وَ + أَكْمَلَ — akmala, form IV of kamula/kamila, 'to complete, perfect' (3ms past)
الْعُلُومَ: الـ + عُلُوم — ʿilm, science (m. pl., acc.)
مَشْغُولًا: mashghūl, preoccupied, busy, engrossed (pass. part. of shaghala, acc. indef.)
أَصْبَحَ: aṣbaḥa, 'to become' (of morning breaking; kāna-sister verb, 3ms past)
وَأَضَاءَ: وَ + أَضَاءَ — aḍāʾa, form IV of ḍāʾa, 'to shine, give light' (3ms past)
بِنُورِهِ: بِـ + نُور + ـهِ — nūr, light (m., gen.) + 3ms pron.
وَلَاحَ: وَ + لَاحَ — lāḥa, 'to appear, gleam' (3ms past)
أَفْخَرَ: afkhar, more/most splendid (elative of fākhir, acc., diptote; first term of iḍāfa, 'the finest of')
ثِيَابِهِ: ثِيَاب + ـهِ — thawb, garment (pl. thiyāb, gen.) + 3ms pron.
الْأَرْضَ: الـ + أَرْض — arḍ, ground, earth (f., acc.)
وَدَعَا: وَ + دَعَا — daʿā, 'to call upon, pray for, invoke' (3ms past)
بِدَوَامِ: بِـ + دَوَام — dawām, continuance, permanence (m., gen.)
الْعِزِّ: الـ + عِزّ — ʿizz, might, glory (m., gen.)
وَالنِّعَمِ: وَ + الـ + نِعَم — niʿma, blessing, grace, favor (f. pl., gen.)
بِنَفْسِهِ: بِـ + نَفْس + ـهِ — nafs, self, soul (f., gen.) + 3ms pron.; 'of himself, in person'
اِعْتَرَاكَ: اِعْتَرَى + ـكَ — iʿtarā, form VIII of ʿarā/ʿariya, 'to befall, come upon' (3ms past; hamzat waṣl, no hamza mark) + 2ms obj.
جَسَدِكَ: جَسَد + ـكَ — jasad, body (m., gen.) + 2ms pron.; 'your body'
وَإِنَّ: وَ + إِنَّ — inna, verily, that (particle governing an acc. subject)
الْحِيلَةَ: الـ + حِيلَة — ḥīla, trick, device, means, stratagem (f., acc.)
ذَهَابِهِ: ذَهَاب + ـهِ — dhahāb, going away, departure (m., gen.) + 3ms pron.
أُدَاوِيكَ: أُدَاوِي + ـكَ — dāwā, form III, 'to treat medically' (1cs impf.) + 2ms obj.; 'I treat you'
أَسْقِيكَ: أَسْقِي + ـكَ — asqā, form IV of saqā, 'to give to drink' (1cs impf.) + 2ms obj.

بِدُهْنٍ: بِـ + دُهْنٍ — duhn, oil, fat, unguent (m., gen. indef.)
تَعَجَّبَ: taʿajjaba, form V, 'to marvel, be amazed' (3ms past)
فَوَاللَّهِ: فَـ + وَ + اللَّه — Allāh, God (gen., after the oath particle wa-); 'for by God'

أُغْنِيكَ: أُغْنِي + ـكَ — aghnā, form IV of ghaniya, 'to enrich' (1cs impf.) + 2ms obj.
أَوْلَادَ: awlād, children (m. pl. of walad, acc.); first term of iḍāfa
الْوَلَدِ: الـ + وَلَد — walad, child, son (m., gen.); 'awlād al-walad', children's children, descendants

وَكُلَّمَا: وَ + كُلَّمَا — kullamā, 'whenever, every time that' (conj.)
تَمَنَّيْتَهُ: تَمَنَّيْتَ + ـهُ — tamannā, form V, 'to wish for, desire' (2ms past) + 3ms obj.
فَهُوَ: فَـ + هُوَ — huwa, he, it (independent pron., 3ms)
وَتَكُونُ: وَ + تَكُونُ — takūnu, 'to be' (2ms impf. of kāna)
نَدِيمِي: نَدِيم + ـِي — nadīm, boon-companion, drinking-companion (m.) + 1cs pron.
وَحَبِيبِي: وَ + حَبِيب + ـِي — ḥabīb, beloved, dear friend (m.) + 1cs pron.

الْمَرَضِ: الـ + مَرَض — maraḍ, illness, disease (m., gen.)

وَطَاعَةً: وَ + طَاعَةً — ṭāʿa, obedience (masdar, acc. of manner)

وَأَكْرَى: وَ + أَكْرَى — akrā (Form IV of ك ر ي), to rent, let out for hire (perf. 3ms); here of the sage taking a house on lease for himself

وَعَقَاقِيرَهُ: وَ + عَقَاقِير + ـهُ — ʿaqāqīr (pl. of ʿaqqār), drug-simples, medicinal herbs (acc.) + 3ms poss.
اِسْتَخْرَجَ: istakhraja — istakhraja (Form X of خ ر ج), to bring out, extract (perf. 3ms)

وَعَمِلَ: وَ + عَمِلَ — ʿamila, to make, do, work (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَصَنَعَ: وَ + صَنَعَ — ṣanaʿa, to make, fashion, craft (verb I, perf. 3ms)
أُكْرَةً: ukra, ball, rounded knob (f., acc. indef.); here the polo-ball
بِمَعْرِفَتِهِ: بِـ + مَعْرِفَة + ـهِ — maʿrifa, knowledge, skill (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'by his own skill'
صَنَعَ: ṣanaʿa — ṣanaʿa, to make, fashion (verb I, perf. 3ms)

الْمَيْدَانِ: الـ + مَيْدَان — maydān, open field, race- or polo-ground (m., gen.)
وَأَنْ: وَ + أَنْ — an, that (subordinating particle governing the subjunctive); wa-, and

الْأُمَرَاءُ: الـ + أُمَرَاء — umarāʾ (pl. of amīr), princes, commanders (m., nom.)

وَأَرْبَابُ: وَ + أَرْبَاب — arbāb (pl. of rabb), lords, masters (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the lords of...'
الدَّوْلَةِ: الـ + دَوْلَة — dawla, state, dynasty, ruling power (f., gen.)
اِسْتَقَرَّ: istaqarra — istaqarra (Form X of ق ر ر), to settle, become fixed, take hold (perf. 3ms)

الْقَبْضَةِ: الـ + قَبْضَة — qabḍa, grip, handle (f., gen.)
وَسُوقْ: وَ + سُقْ (سوق) — imperative of sāqa/yasūqu, to drive on, urge forward (verb I hollow, imperative m.sg.); the edition retains the medial wāw rather than the Classical elided سُقْ
وَتَمَطَّا: وَ + تَمَطَّ (تمطا) — imperative of tamaṭṭā (Form V), to stretch oneself; the edition retains a final long vowel — spelled with alif for yāʾ — where Classical grammar elides it to تَمَطَّ
جَيِّدًا: jayyid, good, thorough, fine (adj., acc. indef.); adverbial, 'well'
وَاِضْرِبْ: وَ + اِضْرِبْ — iḍrib, imperative of ḍaraba/yaḍribu, to strike, hit (verb I, imperative m.sg.)
يَعْرَقَ: yaʿraqa — ʿariqa, to sweat (verb I, impf. subjunctive 3ms after حَتَّى)
كَفُّكَ: كَفّ + ـكَ — kaff, palm, hand (f., nom.) + 2ms poss.
وَجَسَدُكَ: وَ + جَسَد + ـكَ — jasad, body (m., nom.) + 2ms poss.
فَيَنْفُذُ: فَـ + يَنْفُذُ — nafadha/yanfudhu, to pass through, penetrate (verb I, impf. 3ms)
الدَّوَاءُ: الـ + دَوَاء — dawāʾ, medicine, remedy (m., nom.); the edition already prints the hamza here (الدواء)
كَفِّكَ: كَفّ + ـكَ — kaff, palm (f., gen.) + 2ms poss.
فَيَسْرِي: فَـ + يَسْرِي — sarā/yasrī, to flow, course, permeate (verb I defective, impf. 3ms)
فَرَغْتَ: faraghta — faragha, to finish, be done (verb I, perf. 2ms)
وَحَاقَ: وَ + حَاقَ — ḥāqa, to encompass, settle upon, take full effect (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); with fī/bi, 'to take hold in'
فَاِرْجِعْ: فَـ + اِرْجِعْ — irjiʿ, imperative of rajaʿa, to return (verb I, imperative m.sg.)
قَصْرِكَ: قَصْر + ـكَ — qaṣr, palace (m., gen.) + 2ms poss.
وَاُدْخُلْ: وَ + اُدْخُلْ — udkhul, imperative of dakhala, to enter (verb I, imperative m.sg.)

وَنَمْ: وَ + نَمْ — nam, imperative of nāma, to sleep (verb I hollow, imperative m.sg.)
بَرِئْتَ: baraʾta — baraʾa/yabraʾu, to recover, be cured (verb I, perf. 2ms)
وَمَسَكَهُ: وَ + مَسَكَ + ـهُ — masaka, to grip, hold fast (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
وَرَكِبَ: وَ + رَكِبَ — rakiba, to mount, ride (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْجَوَادَ: الـ + جَوَاد — jawād, steed, swift horse (m., acc.)
خَلْفَهَا: خَلْفَ + ـهَا — khalfa, behind (adv. acc.) + 3fs; 'behind it'
لَحِقَهَا: لَحِقَ + ـهَا — laḥiqa, to catch up with, overtake (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
وَضَرَبَهَا: وَ + ضَرَبَ + ـهَا — ḍaraba, to strike, hit (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
بِقُوَّةٍ: بِـ + قُوَّة — quwwa, strength, force (f., gen. indef.); 'with force'
قَبَضَ: qabaḍa — qabaḍa, to grip, close (the hand) (verb I, perf. 3ms)
كَفَّهُ: كَفّ + ـهُ — kaff, hand, palm (f., acc.) + 3ms poss.
قَبْضَةِ: قَبْضَة — qabḍa, grip (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
يَضْرِبُ: yaḍribu — ḍaraba, to strike (verb I, impf. 3ms)
وَيَسُوقُ: وَ + يَسُوقُ — sāqa/yasūqu, to drive on (verb I hollow, impf. 3ms)
وَيَضْرِبُهَا: وَ + يَضْرِبُ + ـهَا — yaḍribu + 3fs obj.; 'and striking it'
عَرِقَ: ʿariqa — ʿariqa, to sweat (verb I, perf. 3ms)
كَفُّهُ: كَفّ + ـهُ — kaff, palm (f., nom.) + 3ms poss.
وَسَائِرُ: وَ + سَائِر — sāʾir, the rest (of), remainder (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa)

وَعَرَفَ: وَ + عَرَفَ — ʿarafa, to know, perceive, realize (verb I, perf. 3ms)
سَرَى: sarā — sarā/yasrī, to flow, permeate (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
فَأَمَرَهُ: فَـ + أَمَرَ + ـهُ — amara, to command, order (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.

الْمَمَالِيكُ: الـ + مَمَالِيك — mamālīk (broken pl. of mamlūk), pages, Mamluks, slave-servants (m., nom.)

لِلْمَلِكِ: لِـ + الـ + مَلِك — malik, king (m., gen.); 'for the king'
قُمَاشَهُ: قُمَاش + ـهُ — qumāsh, cloth, garments, attire (m., acc.) + 3ms poss.

وَأَشَارَ: وَ + أَشَارَ — ashāra (Form IV of ش و ر), to point, gesture, signal (perf. 3ms); with ilā, 'to gesture toward'
بِهَذِهِ: بِـ + هَذِهِ — hādhihi, this (f., dem. pron.); 'with this'

نَهَضَ: nahaḍa — to rise, stand up (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَائِمًا: qāʾim — standing, on one's feet (act. part., m., acc. indef., hāl)

وَأَجْلَسَهُ: وَ + أَجْلَسَ + ـهُ — ajlasa, to seat, make sit (verb IV of j-l-s) + 3ms obj.; 'and he seated him'

السَّنِيَّةَ: الـ + سَنِيَّة — saniyya, sublime, splendid (adj., f. acc., agreeing with al-khilaʿ)
جَسَدُهُ: جَسَد + ـهُ — jasad, body (m., nom., subject of ṣāra) + 3ms poss.; 'his body'
نَقِيًّا: naqiyy(an) — clean, pure (adj., m. acc. indef., predicate of ṣāra)
الْفِضَّةِ: الـ + فِضَّة — fiḍḍa, silver (f., gen. after mithla)
الْبَيْضَاءِ: الـ + بَيْضَاء — bayḍāʾ, white (adj. f., gen., agreeing with al-fiḍḍa)
وَاتَّسَعَ: وَ + اتَّسَعَ — ittasaʿa, to become spacious, expand (verb VIII of w-s-ʿ), perf. 3ms
صَدْرُهُ: صَدْر + ـهُ — ṣadr, breast, chest (m., nom., subject) + 3ms poss.; 'his breast'
وَانْشَرَحَ: وَ + انْشَرَحَ — insharaḥa, to be gladdened, open with joy (verb VII of sh-r-ḥ), perf. 3ms

دَاخَلَكَ: دَاخَلَ + ـكَ — dākhala, to enter into, come over (someone) (verb III, perf. 3ms) + 2ms obj.; idiom, 'it (envy) came over you'
الْحَسَدُ: الـ + حَسَد — ḥasad, envy (m., nom. as subject)
وَتُرِيدُ: وَ + تُرِيدُ — turīdu (< arāda), to want, wish (verb IV, impf. 2ms); 'and you want'
قَتْلَهُ: قَتْل + ـهُ — qatl, killing (m. verbal noun, acc. as object of 'want') + 3ms obj.; 'his killing' = 'to kill him'
أَنْدَمُ: nadima, to regret (verb I, impf. 1cs); 'I will regret' (the hamza of the 1st-person prefix is supplied editorially, the edition printing none)
السِّنْدِبَادُ: الـ + سِنْدِبَاد — al-Sindibād, proper name (m., nom., in apposition to الملك)
قَتْلِ: qatl, killing (m. verbal noun, gen. as object of عَلَى)
الْعَفْوَ: الـ + عَفْو — ʿafw, pardon (m., acc.); elliptical exclamatory request, '[I ask] pardon!'
السِّنْدِبَانِ: الـ + سِنْدِبَان — al-Sindibān, proper name (m., gen.); the edition's own variant spelling of السِّنْدِبَاد found elsewhere in this same tale, kept as printed rather than harmonized
الْفَرَحَ: الـ + فَرَح — faraḥ, joy, delight (m., acc.)
وَالتَّنَزُّهَ: وَ + الـ + تَنَزُّه — tanazzuh, recreation, going out for pleasure (m. verbal noun of verb V, acc.)
وَالصَّيْدَ: وَ + الـ + صَيْد — ṣayd, hunting (m., acc.)
وَالْقَنَصَ: وَ + الـ + قَنَص — qanaṣ, the chase, hunting (m., acc.); a near-synonym of صَيْد paired with it for emphasis
مُرَبِّيَ: مُرَبِّي — murabbī, one who raises, trains (m. act. part. II of رَبَّى, acc., construct); 'a raiser/trainer of'
يُفَارِقُهُ: يُفَارِقُ + ـهُ — fāraqa/yufāriqu, to part from, leave (verb III, impf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
شَائِلَهُ: شَائِل + ـهُ — shāʾil, holding aloft, keeping raised (m. act. part. I of شَالَ 'to lift, raise', acc. as predicate of كَانَ, construct) + 3ms obj.; 'keeping it perched'
يَدِهِ: يَد + ـهِ — yad, hand (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.
يَأْخُذُهُ: يَأْخُذُ + ـهُ — akhadha/yaʾkhudhu, to take (verb I, impf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
وَعَامَلَ: وَ + عَامَلَ — ʿāmala, Classically 'to deal with, treat' (verb III, perf. 3ms); used here in the colloquial sense 'to have (something) made/fixed up for him' still current in spoken Arabic
مُعَلَّقَةً: muʿallaqa, hung, suspended (f. pass. part. II of عَلَّقَ, acc. as adjective)
رَقَبَتِهِ: رَقَبَة + ـهِ — raqaba, neck (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.
يَسْقِيهِ: يَسْقِي + ـهِ — saqā/yasqī, to give to drink, water (verb I defective, impf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
بِأَمِيرِ: بِـ + أَمِير — amīr, commander, officer (m., gen.); here in the obscure title أَمِيرُ الرَّخَةِ, see note on الرَّخَة
الرَّخَةِ: الـ + رَخَة — rakha(h), of uncertain meaning here, apparently a court or hunting title (f., gen.); see note
أَوَانُ: awān, time, season, moment (m., nom. as predicate)
الْخُرُوجِ: الـ + خُرُوج — khurūj, going out, departure (m. verbal noun, gen.)
بِالْخُرُوجِ: بِـ + الـ + خُرُوج — khurūj, departure (m., gen. after بِ); 'for departure'
وَسَارُوا: وَ + سَارُوا — sāra/sārū, to travel, set out (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp)
وَادٍ: wādin, a valley (m., gen. indef., defective/manqūṣ noun)
وَضَرَبُوا: وَ + ضَرَبُوا — ḍaraba, to strike; with حَلْقَة, 'to pitch/form (a ring)' (verb I, perf. 3mp)
حَلْقَةَ: ḥalqa, ring, circle; here the hunting-ring formed by beaters (f., acc.)
بِغَزَالَةٍ: بِـ + غَزَالَة — ghazāla, gazelle (f., gen. indef.)
وَقَعَتْ: وَ + وَقَعَتْ — waqaʿa/waqaʿat, to fall, land, be caught (verb I, perf. 3fs)
نَطَّتِ: naṭṭat, to jump, leap (verb I geminate, perf. 3fs; -i is a helping vowel before the following hamzat waṣl)
دِمَاغِهِ: دِمَاغ + ـهِ — dimāgh, head, brain (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.
فَضَيَّقُوا: فَـ + ضَيَّقُوا — ḍayyaqa, to narrow, tighten (verb II, perf. 3mp)
لِبَيْتِ: لِـ + بَيْت — bayt, tent, house (m., gen.); لِ here stands for إِلَى, 'into', as often in this register
وَثَبَتَتْ: وَ + ثَبَتَتْ — thabatat, she stood firm, steadied herself (verb I, perf. 3fs)
رِجْلَيْهَا: رِجْل + ـَيْ + ـهَا — rijl, leg, foot (f., dual obl.) + 3fs poss.; 'her two legs'
وَحَطَّتْ: وَ + حَطَّتْ — ḥaṭṭat, she set down, placed (verb I, perf. 3fs)
صَدْرِهَا: صَدْر + ـهَا — ṣadr, chest, breast (m., gen.) + 3fs poss.
تَبُوسُ: tabūsu, she kisses (verb I, impf. 3fs; colloquial بَاسَ/يَبُوسُ 'to kiss', beside Classical قَبَّلَ)
فَطَاطَاءَ: فَـ + طَاطَاءَ — ṭāṭaʾa, to bow, lower (the head) (quadriliteral verb, perf. 3ms); a vernacular-shifted spelling of Classical طَأْطَأَ, the medial hamza-sukūn having weakened to a long vowel
لِلْغَزَالَةِ: لِـ + الـ + غَزَالَة — ghazāla, gazelle (f., gen.); 'to the gazelle'
فَفَرَّتْ: فَـ + فَرَّتْ — farrat, she fled, escaped (verb I, perf. 3fs)
فَوْقِ: fawq, above, over (adv./prep., gen. as muḍāf)
رَاحَتْ: rāḥat, she went, departed (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs)
فَظَلَّ: فَـ + ظَلَّ — ẓalla, to remain, continue [doing] (verb I hollow/geminate, perf. 3ms); here loosely followed by a perfect verb rather than the Classical imperfect
يَتَغَامَزُونَ: yataghāmazūna, to wink or exchange glances at one another (verb VI of غَمَزَ, impf. 3mp)
الْعَسْكَرُ: الـ + عَسْكَر — ʿaskar, army, troops (m., nom.)
يَقُولُونَ: yaqūlūna, they say (verb I hollow, impf. 3mp)
قُلْتَ: qulta, you said (verb I hollow, perf. 2ms)
يُقْتَلُ: yuqtalu, he is/shall be killed (verb I, impf. 3ms, passive)
وَحَيَاةِ: وَ + حَيَاة — ḥayāt, life (f., gen., muḍāf after the oath-wāw); 'by the life of'
رَأْسِي: رَأْس + ـِي — raʾs, head (m.) + 1cs poss.; 'my head'
لَأَتْبَعُهَا: لَـ + أَتْبَعُ + ـهَا — tabiʿa/atbaʿu, to follow (verb I, impf. 1cs) + 3fs obj., with the emphatic lām of an oath's response; 'I will surely follow her'
أَجِي: ajī, I come (verb I, impf. 1cs); a colloquial/Middle Arabic form of Classical أَجِيءُ, the final hamza having weakened away, as commonly in spoken Arabic
تَابِعَ: تَابِع — tābiʿ, following, a follower of (m. act. part. I of تَبِعَ, acc. as predicate of ظَلَّ, construct); 'kept following'
وَرَاءَهَا: وَرَاء + ـهَا — warāʾ, behind (adv./prep.) + 3fs; 'behind her, after her'
الْجِبَالِ: الـ + جِبَال — jibāl, mountains (m. pl. of جَبَل, gen.)
فَأَرَادَتْ: فَـ + أَرَادَتْ — arādat, she wanted, intended (verb IV, perf. 3fs)
تَعْبُرَ: taʿbura, that she cross (verb I, subj. 3fs, after أَنْ)
فَسَيَّبَ: فَـ + سَيَّبَ — sayyaba, to release, let loose (an animal) (verb II, perf. 3ms)
يَلْطُشُهَا: يَلْطُشُ + ـهَا — laṭasha/yalṭushu, to strike, peck at (colloquial verb I, impf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
عَيْنَيْهَا: عَيْن + ـَيْ + ـهَا — ʿayn, eye (f., dual obl.) + 3fs poss.; 'her two eyes'
أَعْمَاهَا: أَعْمَى + ـهَا — aʿmā, to blind (verb IV of عَمِيَ, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
وَدَوَّخَهَا: وَ + دَوَّخَ + ـهَا — dawwakha, to make dizzy, daze (verb II of دَاخَ, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
فَسَحَبَ: فَـ + سَحَبَ — saḥaba, to draw, pull out (verb I, perf. 3ms)
دَبُّوسًا: dabbūs, mace, club (m., acc. indef.; Persian loanword)
قَلْبَهَا: قَلْب + ـهَا — qalb, heart (m., acc.) + 3fs poss.
ذَبَحَهَا: ذَبَحَ + ـهَا — dhabaḥa, to slaughter (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
وَعَلَّقَهَا: وَ + عَلَّقَ + ـهَا — ʿallaqa, to hang, suspend (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
سَاعَةَ: sāʿa, hour, time (f., acc. as predicate of كَانَتْ)
قَيَالَةٍ: qayāla(h), midday rest, siesta (f., gen. indef.); an uncertain form, apparently related to Classical قَيْلُولَة, see note
الْغَابَةُ: الـ + غَابَة — ghāba, forest, wilderness (f., nom.)
مُقْفِرَةً: muqfira, desolate, uninhabited (f. act. part. IV of أَقْفَرَ, acc. as predicate)
يُوجَدْ: yūjad, is found (verb I, passive jussive after لَمْ)
فَعَطِشَ: فَـ + عَطِشَ — ʿaṭisha, to become thirsty (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَعَطِشَ: وَ + عَطِشَ — ʿaṭisha, to become thirsty (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْحِصَانُ: الـ + حِصَان — ḥiṣān, horse, stallion (m., nom.)
فَدَوَّرَ: فَـ + دَوَّرَ — dawwara, to search around, look about (verb II of دَارَ, perf. 3ms)
فَرَأَى: فَـ + رَأَى — raʾā, to see (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
نَازِلًا: nāzil, descending, dripping down (m. act. part. I of نَزَلَ, acc., circumstantial)
السَّمْنِ: الـ + سَمْن — samn, clarified butter, ghee (m., gen.)
لَابِسَ: lābis, wearing (m. act. part. I of لَبِسَ, acc. as predicate of كَانَ, construct)
كُفُوفٍ: kufūf, gloves (m. pl. of كَفّ 'palm', gen. indef.)
السُّرَادِقِ: الـ + سُرَادِق — surādiq, a large tent, pavilion (m., gen.)
فَأَخَذَ: فَـ + أَخَذَ — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الطَّاسَةَ: الـ + طَاسَة — ṭāsa, cup, bowl (f., acc.; Persian loanword)
وَمَلَأَهَا: وَ + مَلَأَ + ـهَا — malaʾa, to fill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
وَوَضَعَ: وَ + وَضَعَ — waḍaʿa, to put, place (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قُدَّامَهُ: قُدَّام + ـهُ — quddām, in front of, before (adv./prep.) + 3ms; 'before him'
بِالْبَازِ: بِـ + الـ + بَاز — bāz, falcon (m., gen.)
لَطَسَ: laṭasa, to knock, strike (colloquial verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَلَبَهَا: qalaba, to overturn, upset (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
ثَانِيًا: thāniyan, a second time (m., acc. adverbial)
النَّفْطَ: الـ + نَفْط — naft, naphtha, an oily substance (m., acc.); here describing the oily-looking liquid dripping from the tree — possibly a misprint for النُّقْطَة, 'the drop' (ف/ق are easily confused), see note
النَّازِلَةَ: الـ + نَازِلَة — nāzila, descending, dripping (f. act. part. I of نَزَلَ, acc.)
مَلَأَهَا: malaʾa, to fill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
وَظَنَّ: وَ + ظَنَّ — ẓanna, to think, suppose (verb I geminate, perf. 3ms)
فَوَضَعَهَا: فَـ + وَضَعَ + ـهَا — waḍaʿa, to place (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
فَلَطَسَهَا: فَـ + لَطَسَ + ـهَا — laṭasa, to knock, strike (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
فَانْقَبَضَ: فَـ + اِنْقَبَضَ — inqabaḍa, to be vexed, put out (verb VII of قَبَضَ, perf. 3ms)
وَقَامَ: وَ + قَامَ — qāma, to rise, stand up (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
وَمَلَاءَ: وَ + مَلَاءَ — malāʾa, to fill (verb I, perf. 3ms); a lengthened vernacular spelling of Classical مَلَأَ (compare فَطَاطَاءَ above), with the hamza written bare after an extra long alif
وَقَدَّمَهَا: وَ + قَدَّمَ + ـهَا — qaddama, to offer, present (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
لِلْحِصَانِ: لِـ + الـ + حِصَان — ḥiṣān, horse (m., gen.); 'to the horse'
فَقَلَبَهَا: فَـ + قَلَبَ + ـهَا — qalaba, to overturn (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
بِجَنَاحِهِ: بِـ + جَنَاح + ـهِ — janāḥ, wing (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.
يُشَيِّبُكَ: يُشَيِّبُ + ـكَ — shayyaba, to make grey-haired, age (someone) (verb II of شَابَ, jussive/optative 3ms 'may he...') + 2ms obj.; imprecation, 'may God age you [with grief]!'
أَيْشَمَ: أَيْشَم — ashʾam, most ill-omened (elative of شُؤْم, construct/vocative form); the ي stands in for the expected medial hamza (compare نَايِمَة), a colloquial hamza-weakening
الطُّيُورِ: الـ + طُيُور — ṭuyūr, birds (m. pl. of طَيْر, gen.)
أَحْرَمْتَنِي: أَحْرَمْتَ + ـنِي — aḥrama, to deprive (verb IV of حَرَمَ, perf. 2ms) + 1cs obj.
وَأَحْرَمْتَ: وَ + أَحْرَمْتَ — aḥramta, you deprived (verb IV, perf. 2ms)
نَفْسَكَ: نَفْس + ـكَ — nafs, self, soul (f., acc.) + 2ms poss.; 'yourself'
بِالسَّيْفِ: بِـ + الـ + سَيْف — sayf, sword (m., gen.)
أَجْنِحَتَهُ: أَجْنِحَة + ـهُ — ajniḥa, wings (m. broken pl. of جَنَاح, acc.) + 3ms poss.
يُقِيمُ: yuqīmu, he raises, lifts (verb IV of قَامَ, impf. 3ms)
انْظُرْ: unẓur, look! (verb I imperative 2ms, hamzat waṣl — no hamza mark is added, as the alif carries no true glottal stop)
عَيْنَهُ: عَيْن + ـهُ — ʿayn, eye (f., acc.) + 3ms poss.
فَرْخَ: farkh, the young (of a bird or creature), a chick (m., acc., construct)
آفَةٍ: āfa, a pest, a blight, a harmful creature; here concretely 'a viper, a snake' (f., gen. indef.)
سَمُّهَا: سَمّ + ـهَا — samm, poison, venom (m., nom.) + 3fs poss.
فَنَدِمَ: فَـ + نَدِمَ — nadima, to regret (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَصِّ: qaṣṣ, cutting, clipping (m. verbal noun of قَصَّ, gen.)
أَجْنِحَةِ: ajniḥa, wings (m. broken pl. of جَنَاح, gen.)
حِصَانَهُ: حِصَان + ـهُ — ḥiṣān, horse (m., acc.) + 3ms poss.
الْوَطَاقِ: الـ + وَطَاق — waṭāq, camp, tent-enclosure (m., gen.; loanword)
بِمَتَاعِهِ: بِـ + مَتَاع + ـهِ — matāʿ, gear, belongings (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.
فَأَعْطَى: فَـ + أَعْطَى — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
شَوِّهَا: شَوِّ + ـهَا — shawwā/shawwi, to roast, grill (verb II, imperative 2ms) + 3fs obj.
الْكُرْسِيِّ: الـ + كُرْسِيّ — kursī, chair, seat (m., gen.)
وَالْبَازُ: وَ + الـ + بَاز — bāz, falcon (m., nom.)
فَتَحَقَّقَ: فَـ + تَحَقَّقَ — taḥaqqaqa, to be verified, ascertained (verb V of حَقَّ, perf. 3ms)
فَصَرَخَ: فَـ + صَرَخَ — ṣarakha, to cry out, shout (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَأَسَفًا: وَ + أَسَفًا — asaf, sorrow, regret (m., acc. adverbial); the edition prints the hamza here, kept as given
وَكَوْنِهِ: وَ + كَوْن + ـهِ — kawn, being (m. verbal noun of كَانَ, gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'and its/his being [that it had...]'
الْهَلَاكِ: الـ + هَلَاك — halāk, destruction, ruin (m., gen.)
الْعَظِيمُ: الـ + عَظِيم — ʿaẓīm, great, mighty (adj., m. nom.); in apposition to الملك
الشَّأْنِ: الـ + شَأْن — shaʾn, affair, rank, importance (m., gen.); in عَظِيمُ الشَّأْنِ, 'great of rank'; the edition prints its hamza-seat alif bare, so a combining hamza is supplied
رَأَيْتُ: raʾaytu — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I saw'
سُوْءًا: سُوء — sūʾ, evil, harm (m., acc. indef.); 'any evil'
وَإِنَّمَا: وَ + إِنَّمَا — wa-innamā, and only, but rather (restrictive particle)
شَفَقَةً: shafaqa — pity, compassion, concern (f., acc. of cause/manner); 'out of compassion'
وَلِأَجْلِ: وَ + لِـ + أَجْل — ajl, sake, reason (m., gen.); li-ajli, 'for the sake of'
تَعْلَمَ: taʿlama — ʿalima, to know (verb I, subjunctive 2ms after أَنْ)
صِحَّةَ: ṣiḥḥa — soundness, correctness, truth (f., acc.); 'the truth of that'
هَلَكْتَ: halakta — halaka, to perish (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you would perish'
هَلَكَ: halaka — to perish, die (verb I, perf. 3ms)
اِحْتَالَ: iḥtāla — form VIII of حول/حيل, 'to scheme, use a stratagem' (perf. 3ms, hamzat waṣl)
اِبْنِ: اِبْن — ibn, son (m., gen., hamzat waṣl); first term of iḍāfa
الْمُحْتَالِ: الـ + مُحْتَال — muḥtāl, scheming, crafty (act. part. of اِحْتَالَ, m. gen.); 'the scheming [vizier]'
وَلَدٌ: walad — son, boy, child (m., nom. indef.)
مُولَعٌ: mūlaʿ — devoted, addicted (pass. part. of form IV وَلِعَ, m. nom. indef.)
بِالصَّيْدِ: بِـ + الـ + صَيْد — ṣayd, hunting (m., gen.)
لِأَبِيهِ: لِـ + أَبِيهِ — li-, to/of + abīhi, his father (oblique of أب + 3ms); 'belonging to his father'
أَمَرَهُ: amarahu — amara, to command, order (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'he commanded him'
يَكُونَ: yakūna — kāna, to be (verb I hollow, subjunctive 3ms after أَنْ)
تَوَجَّهَ: tawajjaha — form V, 'to set off, head [somewhere]' (perf. 3ms)
الْوَلَدُ: الـ + وَلَد — walad, boy, son (m., nom.)
فَسَارُوا: فَـ + سَارُوا — sāra, to travel, set off (verb I, perf. 3mp)
فَنَظَرُوا: فَـ + نَظَرُوا — naẓara, to look, catch sight of (verb I, perf. 3mp)
وَحْشِيٍّ: waḥshiyy — wild (nisba adj. used substantively for 'a wild beast'; m. gen. indef.)
كَبِيرٍ: kabīr — great, large (adj., m. gen. indef.)
لِاِبْنِ: لِـ + اِبْن — li- + ibn, son; 'to the son [of the king]'

يَقْدِرُ: يَقْدِرُ — qadara/yaqdiru, to be able (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'he is able'
